tei:div.tei:p: karma pa sku phreng dang po

dus gsum mkhyen pa'i lo rgyus/ bsgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang brgyud pa rin po che'i rnam par thar pa rab 'byams nor bu zla ba chu shel gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /srid zhi'i dge legs kun gyi 'byung gnas gcig/ ma lus rgyal ba kun 'dus kun gyi phul// bka' brgyud rin chen phreng ba'i zhabs pad mchog/ tshangs pa'i gnas su 'bral med rtag par mchod// gang zhig dran pas 'khor ba'i gdung sel zhing*// bsam kun yongs su rdzogs mdzad grags dkar gyis// 'khor yug rgyas 'gengs rgyal ba'i rnam par thar// yid bzhin nor bu'i tshogs la phyag bgyi'o// tshangs sogs cher snyems rnams kyi gtsug phud kyis// lan brgyar phyis pa khyod zhabs me long du// dge mtshan mi shar bya ba mi srid pas// gzugs mang po des deng 'dir skyong gyur cig/ sgrub pa po rnams grub pa'i rjes su snyeg/ mkhas 'dod rnams ni mkhas la gcig tu 'dun// blun po rnams kyang grags pa la 'chel bas// gtam gyi sbyor bas thams cad 'drid byed kyang*// rin chen rin thang med pa'i kha byang bzhin// bden gtam dag kyang glo bar chud dka' bas// thos pas don ldan nges par mi bslu ba'i// dam pa'i rnam thar shas tsam gleng bar bya// de la yul bsil ldan gyi ljongs 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che rma med pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa'i dbus su nyin mor byed pa ltar gsal zhing rmad du byung ba ni mar mi'i bka' brgyud spyi dang*/ khyad par karma'i bka' brgyud 'di yin zhing*/ de dag la chos 'byung gi lo rgyus dang rnam thar gyi yi ge sogs rgyas zhing gsal ba du ma dag mchis mod kyi/ 'dir dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje'i bdag nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bkas bskul bar mdzad pa bzhin du/ sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang gi bla ma rnams kyi rnam par thar pa sngar bsgrigs pa rnams rgyas par spel zhing*/ bla ma phyi ma rnams kyi rnam par thar pas kha 'gengs pa bcas bgyid par spro'o//

de'ang dpal tai lo pa chen pos bka' babs bzhi'i bla ma sogs bsten par mdzad kyang nye brgyud kyi dbang du byas nas rdo rje 'chang dngos kyis dpal til+li pa rjes su bzungs/ des mchog gi dngos grub chen po'i go 'phang brnyes nas nā ro dzñā na sid+dhi rjes su bzungs/ de ni bar dor mchog gi dngos grub brnyes par dam pa 'ga' zhig bzhed cing don du'ang gnas la/ des rje btsun lho brag pa chen po mar pa chos kyi blo gros rjes su bzungs/ des dbang phyug mi la ras pa rjes su bzungs/ des snyi ba chen po 'dzam gling grags pa rjes su bzungs te/ de rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ni gzhan du shes par bya la/ rje snyi ba chen po'i slob ma'i mchog khams pa mi gsum du grags pa las/ khams pa dbu se'am/ mtshan dngos dharma kir+t+ti ste/ chos kyi rje dpal ldan karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa zhes yongs su graḍa pa bdag cag karma kaṃ tshang zhes grags pa'i bka' brgyud rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu'o// de yang bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas drug pa seng ge sgra'i rnam 'phrul du paṇa chen shākya shrī dang*/ bla ma zhang gis kyang lung bstan cing*/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos ma 'ongs pa na thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa thod rgal ba re skabs su 'byung bas 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che byed ces lung bstan pa bzhin 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par yongs su grags pas/ bskal bzang gi byang sems thams cad ni sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa nas byang chub brnyes shing spyan ras gzigs dang rang bzhin dbyer med pa yin pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i rnam par thar pa zab cing rgya che ba dag gi cha shas tsam yang su zhig gis brjod par ga la nus/ 'on kyang tshur mthong gi gdul bya rnams kyi ngor ji tsam zhig snang ba'i cha shas tsam zhig rnam thar gyi yi ge tshor 'byung ba bzhin brjod na sku 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/

mdo smad shar phyogs kyi sa'i cha tre shod gangs kyi ra ba'i yul gyi bye brag ra stag ces sam/ sbo chu lha sdong dkar po zhes par yab gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa sgom pa ste/ sngags 'chang rdo rje mgon zhes bya ba dang*/ yum rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma lha thog bza' sgang lcam ming 'dren gyi sras su/ rngog lo tsā ba gshegs pa'i phyi lo lcags pho stag la sku bltams/ mtshan dge 'phel du btags/ mes po sgom pa bgres po stong dpon shes rab mgon po dang yab la lha mo'i sgrub thabs zhus nas/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa la lha mo bsgrub pas zhal gzigs brag la zhabs rjes kyang byung*/ de'i tshe 'du ru'i grong na dgra zhig yod pa don gnyer la song ba'i lam du rtas brdabs te bsad pas/ chos skyong la gtang rag btang zhing nus mthu phul du byung ba'i grags pa thob/ bla ma bai ro tsa na badz+ra dang*/ dpal 'dzin yang mjal nas gdams ngag mang po dang*/ mchog sred kyi lugs kyi mgon po'i skor yang zhus te sgrub pa mdzad/ dgung lo bcu drug pa la/ tre ka brag ces bya ba'i bka' gdams kyi dgon par mkhan po mchog gi bla ma dang*/ slob dpon chag seng ge grags las rab tu byung nas/ /dpal chos kyi grags pa zhes bya ba'i mtshan gsol lo/ /gnyis su mkhan po'i zhabs tog dang dge 'dun gyi bya ba mdzad/ jo bo'i slob ma yol chos dbang dang*/ de'i slob ma dge bshes kra ra ba mched gnyis la jo bo lugs kyi bde mchog gi dbang dang*/ mi g.yo ba sogs gsang sngags kyi sgrub thabs mang po dang*/ bka' gdams kyi chos skor ci rigs gsan zhing bsgrubs pas grub rtags thon pa byung*/ de nas dgung lo bcu dgu bzhes pa na dbus su byon/ nyi shu la stod lung se thang du dge bshes rgya dmar ba'i grwa sar rta sga phog rgya dmar ba dang*/ dge bshes phywa pa chos seng gnyis la dbu ma rang rgyud shar gsum dang tshad ma dang byams chos gsan/

gsang phur yang bzhugs te khams pa mi gsum du grags/ pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma grags la dbu ma rigs tshogs gsan/ 'phan yul du dge bshes sha ra ba dang*/ de'i slob ma rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje dang gnyis lo drug tu bsten te bka' gdams kyi chos ji snyed pa gsan/ gzhan yang thos bsam mang du mdzad/ mkhan po mal 'dul 'dzin/ las slob ye shes blo gros/ gsang ston mkhan po cung gis mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa bzhes nas 'dul ba la mkhas par mdzad/ de'i tshe 'phan yul rgyal lha khang du dpal rga lo dang*/ khams pa a seng bzhugs pa la dus 'khor sbyor drug dang*/ mgon po bya rog ma la sogs pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa mang du gsan/ de nas dgung lo sum cu bzhes pa'i tshe chos kyi rje sgam po pa mjal bar bzhed de byon pas/ dwags po brag kha'i dgon par dge bshes sha ba gling pa dang*/ slob dpon sgom tshul gnyis bzhugs pa dang mjal/ slob dpon sgom pa la gdan bzhi gsan zhing slob dpon sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gzigs/ de nas dwags lha sgam por byon/ zla ba gnyis tsam mjal kha ma byung*/ mjal ma thag nas dar bcu tsam phul nas gdams ngag zhus pa dang*/ bka' gdams kyi lam rim tho re ba zhig gsungs nas ngas kyang 'di bsgoms pa yin/ khyod rang yang de sgom gsungs zhu sna dang bdag rkyen thams cad slob dpon sgom pas mdzad/ sgam po dang mjal ba'i lo 'di chos rjes re gcig bzhes pa'i sa lug lo yin zhes rnam thar mdzad pa la phal cher bzhed cing*/ gzhon nu byang chub kyis bsgrigs pa'i rnam thar re'u mig mar ni dus mkhyen zhabs kyis dgung lo so gsum bzhes pa'i skabs su yin par bris snang*/ de nas chos rje la dgyes rdor gyi dbang bskur gsan/ chos rje dgyes mdzad rdo rje 'od kyi ra bar bzhugs pa zhig tu gzigs/ thabs lam gyi gdams ngag zhus nas bsgoms pas zhag dgu nas drod rang 'bar du byung*/

na bza' chig rkyang byas nas zla ba dgur phyag rngul dang ma bral bar bsgoms pas ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan dpag tu med pa 'khrungs/ chos rjes lung bstan nas zangs ri la bsgom du byon te/ til phug tu zla ba bzhi/ phag mo grur zla ba gcig dang zhag lnga bsgoms pas sems gnas la rang dbang thob pa dang rlung nyams dpag tu med pa byung*/ lhag mthong sprin bar gyi nyi ma lta bu'ang byung*/ slar bla ma'i spyan sngar byon nas sgam por lo gsum dka' thub drag po mdzad cing bsgoms pas sgom chen brgyad brgya'i nang nas sgom sran che bar grags/ de nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin 'ol dkar bsgom du byon/ bre gu ri bo che'i brag phug gcig tu+u bzhugs pas bud med gcig byung nas khyod 'dir ma 'dug nga'i ma jo 'ong zer bas de brag srin mo yin par dgongs nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la gnad du+u bsnun te zla ba bcu bzhir bzhugs pas drod klung du tshud/ rtags ngo mtshar can mang po byung*/ nges shes khyad par can thugs la 'khrungs pas shin tu dgyes nas/ chos rje bya lkog dgon pa na bzhugs par byon/ rtogs pa phul bas khams pa se bo la nga re che ba yin pa la khyod kyi nor nas 'dug pas da dung bsgoms gsungs/ nga'i de nor sa mi 'dug kyang bla ma'i bka' yin dgongs nas sgam por zla ba drug bsgoms pas sngar gyi de las ma 'gyur/ yang bla ma la lor bsgoms kyang ngo bo la bskyed 'ong rgyu mi 'dug pas nor na'ang nga rang gi de ga bsgoms pa lags zhus pas/ phyag spyi bor bzhag nas bu 'khor ba dang 'brel thag chod pa yin no gsungs/ gnas lugs don gyi ngo sprod gnang*/ yang chos rje'i bka' bzhin du gtsang phyogs la stod man chad du ldom bu la byon pa'i tshe gnyal la lam phyung nas lho brag brgyud dpal rir byon/ khams pa bzhi dang 'grogs nas phag ri na tshur byon pa'i la kha zhig tu dpon slob lngas gro btab/

gnyis shing 'thur song*/ gnyis thab ka byed pa'i tshe thog lhung nas mdun gyi gnyis la phog pas shi/ rin po che la rmi lam gyi snang ba tsam las ma byung*/ de nas la stod kyi mdar me nyag gi yul du/ bla ma mi la'i slob ma dge tshul spun gnyis 'dug pa'i chung ba de la phyag rgya chen po rde'u skor gyi gdams ngag zhus/ jo bo'i slob ma rong pa 'gar dge dang*/ de'i slob ma span phug pa ston rgyal gnyis la bde mchog gi dbang bskur dang*/ rdo rje phag mo chos spyod 'brel ba rin chen rgyan drug dang*/ dbang bzhi nyams bsgom la sogs zhus/ mes tshon po'i slob ma rkyang mo spang kha ba la dgyes rdor gdams bshad zhus/ de nas mar pheb nas phan yul bya bzang brag la dbyar dgun gsum 'dag sbyar gyis sgrub pa mdzad pas gtum mo'i yon tan dpag tu med pa byung*/ bai ro tsa nī'i sngags dang ā li kā li dang*/ ḍā ma ru'i sgra dngos su nam mkha' las gsan/ bde mchog yab yum zhal gzigs/ gzhan snang du brag la thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pas bla ma brag par grags/ sku chab bdud rtsi zhal lud sogs thams cad kyang yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel kha dog sna tshogs pa dbyibs su yig 'bru/ mchod rten phyag mtshan sogs mtha' yas pa byon pa brag phug gang yod par grags/ yang chos rje'i drung du byon te/ sgam por zla ba dgu bzhugs/ der chos rjes lung bstan te tshwa bre lnga khyer nas mon gyi ga thung gi rtsar byon/ de'i btsun mo bod mo zhig 'dug pas pha ming gi zhen byas te lo tsār bsgyur/ tshā des phyag rten byas nas rgyal po dang mjal/ rgyal pos kyang chos gnas su bkur/ sha 'ug stag sgo'i dom tshang shel gyi brag phug ces bya bar bzhugs/ lan gcig rgyags zad nas grong du byon pa'i lam khar nags gseb nas stag gcig byung ba dang*/ pha wang zhig gi steng du bzhugs pas der bskor ba mang po byas nas song*/

de nas cung zad byon pa'i lam du bud med gnyis kyis ku ba phyed brags thod pa 'dra ba zhig chang gis bkang nas drangs/ rgyal po'i pho brang nas rgyags blangs te slar ri la gshegs shing sgrub pa mdzad/ de nas rgyal pos ras dos 'ga' dang dug sngags zhig brdzong bar phul te bod du tshur byon/ lam du lo ror rje btsun chen po ras chung ba dang mjal/ zhag bzhi bcu bsten nas chos drug dang*/ thun 'jog la sogs pa nā ro me tri'i gdams ngag mang du gsan zhing*/ thabs lam la smar khrid du mdzad pas bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang ngo 'phrod pa me long las bzhin mthong ba lta bu byung gsung*/ yang rje btsun mi la'i slob ma rtse mo nam mkha' gsal sgron zhes bya ba la zab mo'i gdams ngag zhus/ de nas sgam por byon chos rje dang mjal ba'i dus su/ chos rje'i zhal nas khyod la bskor ba byed pa'i stag de mkha' 'gro ma'i sprul pa yin/ bdud rtsi 'dren pa'i bud med gnyis kyang zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro mas dngos grub ster ba yin gsungs/ der lo gcig bzhugs nas yang bla ma'i bkas jo mo gangs dkar du byon/ slob dpon pad+ma'i bzhugs gnas pha wang dkar leb du dbyar zla ba bzhi bcud len mdzad kyin bzhugs/ de'i tshe mkha' 'gro mas 'tsho ba drangs nyams rtogs khyad par can thugs la 'khrungs/ lar mos gus med na yon tan mi 'byung*/ ngas bla ma la tha mal gyi 'du shes skad cig kyang skye ma myong*/ khyad par de dus bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes byung gsungs/ ston ka snye mo nye drung gi 'phrang la mar byon tsa rdzing la zhig la khang pa zhig gi mdun du bud med bzhi thags 'thags gin snang*/ bud med gcig gis jo bo dro gsol zer bas rung gsungs/ gcig nang du song nas yar byon zer/ phyir khyer shog byas pas cang mi nyen nang du byon zer/ pheb tsa na bud med bzhi po nang na snang bas ku ba phyed pa thod phor 'dra ba zhig gi nang du bza' btung drangs/

phyag tshang ba bud med de'i mthe bong la bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum dang bcas pa zhig gzigs/ bza' btung de mi'i sor mdzub kyi tshod mar 'dug kyang the tshom med par gsol bas ro mchog brgya dang ldan par byung*/ yang bud med des phor pa nam mkha' la zed tsa na 'o ma 'dra bas gang ba drangs te gsol bas ting nge 'dzin nam mkha' mtha' dbus med pa lta bu thugs la 'khrungs/ sgor byon tsa na bud med bzhi sgo na thags 'thags kyin snang*/ der mar byon pa'i lam du sa gzhi dar gyi 'bol stan ltar 'jam pa dang*/ sku ras bal ltar yang ba dang*/ yid ngos bzung med par dga' ba byung*/ de nas gzhu snye gnyis kyi bar na rdzong zhes pa'i dgon pa'i mdun na btsun ma zhig phyugs 'tsho ba dang 'phrad/ ya ki'i dgon pa na su bzhugs dris pas nga'i slob dpon bzhugs zer/ 'o na mjal bar zhu dang gsungs pas mtshams byas yod zer/ cis kyang mjal bar zhu gsungs pas ngas bla ma la zhu yi zer nas song*/ dar cig nas yar byon zer nang du byon pas btsun rgan pho mo gnyis snang ba la phyag mdzad pas/ phyag ma byed gsungs nas btsun ma yod kyi brda' mdzad kyang phyag legs par 'tshal/ de nas ja gral du bla ma'i zhal nas khyod la de ring bud med bzhis dro drangs ba'i tshod ma'i rgyu de bal yul pham thing na khyim bdag a shwa ka'i bu dhar+m+ma sid+dhi shi ba'i ro ta rti ta'i dur khrod du bskyal ba mkha' 'gro mas blangs pa yin/ bud med de kun mkha' 'gro ma yin gsungs/ da lta de na yod dam dris pas der med/ kha che'i grong khyer sam bha ta'i dur khrod na zla ba nag pa'i nyi shu lnga la/ mkha' 'gro ma 'du ba'i tshogs mchod la song zin/ mkha' 'gro mas khyed la dngos grub ster ba yin/ mon gyi lam du btung ba drangs mkhan de gnyis kyang mkha' 'gro ma yin gsungs/ rje'i thugs la khong gi dgon pa 'di bla ma'i 'phar tshang dgon pa de 'dra snyam du dgongs tshe/

khyed kyi bla ma'i 'phar tshang dgon pa de nga'i 'di 'dra 'ong gsungs/ der rje btsun gyi bsam mno mdzad ma spob ste/ de la sogs pa mang du gsungs/ der bla ma rdzong bal phyag rgya chen po thog bab dang*/ thabs lam gyi gdams ngag mang du gsan/ khyed kyi bla ma lha rjes ci gsung gyis gsung ba sogs zhal lta'ang mang du mdzad de/ sgam por phyag 'bul du pheb pa na/ chos rje'i zhal nas do nub grol sgom dang khams pa se bo gnyis sdod gsung nas nyams dga' ba'i zhal lta mang du phebs/ khyod la de 'dra ba mkhyen pa'i bla ma yod dam gsungs/ yod zhus pas bla ma de nā ro pa'i gsum slob yin gsungs/ sngar mkha' 'gros 'tsho ba drangs ba sogs ji lta ba bzhin bla mas mkhyen nas gsungs shing*/ nga'i bla ma mi la de zad par me'i teng nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas dus su/ ngas mes rnam par mthong nas dos/ chu'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i dus su chu lteng zhig tu mthong*/ zad par gyi yon tan dang mngon shes rgya chen po mnga' yang khong la rlom pa rdul tsam med/ spyir sgom chen pa yon tan la rloms pa skye mi rung gsungs nas/ gzhan la ma gnang ba'i bskyed rim lhan cig skyes ma dang*/ rdzogs rim rlung sems gnyis med sogs gdams ngag thams cad lhag ma ma lus pa gnang*/ yang bla ma'i zhal nas nga kaṃ po gnas nang du 'gro bsdogs byas tsam na zhabs bsnyung bas 'gro ma btub pas/ bu khyod sgrub pa khams kyi kaṃ po gangs rar gyis/ 'gro don dbus gtsang khams gsum khyab par byung ngo zhes lung bstan/ zangs lung du slob dpon sgoms pa la phyag bskyal bas kyang de rnams thams cad mkhyen nas tshur gsungs so//

yang grogs mched bzhis sgom tshul la dbang bskur zhus pas bzhi po mthong snang gcig par dpal he ru kar gzigs nas bla ma nyid la zhus pas/ he ru ka ni nga nyid yin gsungs/ spyir dgyes rdor la lan gsum dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'od phung sogs su gzigs so/ /skabs 'dir khams pa mi gsum 'dzom nas chang khrims dam por yod kyang so so'i rdzu 'phrul dang bcas pa'i tshogs 'khor gsang thabs su mdzad/ 'on kyang nyams 'ur te gsol 'debs spro mo che byas pas zhal ta bas gnas nas phyung*/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad phyir 'breng*/ shing rtsi kun rtse gug /chos rje yang thang rkyang dang sba ber bsnams te/ khong gsum gar 'gro bar nga rang yang 'gro gsungs nas byon/ dri ba dris lan gyi mgur mdzad pas nyams 'ur ste/ pha wang zhig gi steng du gsum po'i zhabs rjes kyis gang ste slar byon nas kun gyis rtsod med du bkur/ de nas yar byon nas dpal chen chu bo rir zla gcig lhag tsam dang*/ gzhu smad kyi lha ri rgyan po la dbyar zla ba gsum bzhugs/ de'i dgun gru bzhi dgon pa bzung ste/ 'di la rjes dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa lcags mo bya'i lo yin par bshad/ der bud med gcig gis 'tsho ba drangs te mkha' 'gro mar 'dug gsungs/ 'di phan chad du lto gos 'dzom po ma byung yang*/ ci yod bzhi sde dang*/ tshogs sogs kho na byas lto gos kyi phyir sgrub pa la thang lhod shor ma myong*/ nga'i dka' las tsam sus mi nus lto rgyab la gyong bskur mi nus par dang po nas 'dzom po 'dod pa la chos mi yong gsungs/ de'i tshe bla ma bai ro la dbang dang byin rlabs zhus nas bde mchog lhan skyes dang*/ rje btsun ma u rgyan ma dang*/ tai lo'i do ha dang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i gtum mo sogs mang du gsan/ de skabs shig tu chos rje rin po che sku yal ba gsan nas byon pas/ pho rog rdzong chung bya ba'i dgon par rje sgom pa dang*/

bla ma 'phags pa dpon slob bzhugs pa dang mjal/ rje'i na bza' la 'jus shing gsol ba drag tu btab ste spyan chab phyung bas/ chos rje rin po che mngon sum du nam mkha' la byon pa dpon slob gsum kas gzigs nas phyag btsal tsam na de nyid du yal lo/ /spyir gru bzhi dgon du lo brgyad bzhugs*/ 'tshogs pa bzhi bcu tsam byung*/ skal ldan mang po la phan thogs/ yo byad ci byung 'phral dgos ma gtogs par bla ma gnyis la 'bul ba mdzad/ de'i tshe thugs dam don zhags kyi bsnyung gnas mang po mdzad/ khyad par du rdo rje phag mo'i bsnyen sgrub mang du mdzad pas zhal gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa zhal gzigs/ yang nub gcig rmang lam du sbrul chen po zhig gis ded de mtho ri rtser/ dma' rgya mtshor bros kyang ma thar/ nam mkha' la 'phur grab mdzad pas sbrul des sku lus khyur mid byas/ mtheb chen phyir lus pa zhig byung*/ de'i tshe nye gnas drung du sleb nas phal pa rnams 'dres non pa lta bu+u ci lags sam zhus pas/ rmi lam 'di 'dra ba zhig rmis te khyod kyi 'dre yin nam gsungs/ de nas zhag 'ga' lon tsa nye gnas la bla ma'i zhal nas mdang zhag rmi lam de bzang po yang dag par gcig yin par 'dug sngar ting nge 'dzin la dran pas cung zad 'dzin dgos pa de da mi dgos pa zhig byung*/ de yang zhag 'ga' 'dzin dgos byung ba de mtheb chen lus pa de la blta bar 'dug /rmi lam de rtsa rlung gi rten 'brel rlung sems a ba dhū tir tshud pa'i rtags su 'dug gsungs te/ de phyin chad byis pa chung ngu'i spyod pa mdzad pa zhig byung ngo*/ /yang nub gcig ri mthon po zhig gi steng nas dar dkar po zhig phyar bas rgya gar nag tshun chad kyis mthong zhing thams cad kyi ltad mo byed pa zhig rmis pa da lta phal cher la grags pa 'di la lta ba 'dra gsungs/ de nas kaṃ po gnas nang du 'gro ba'am snyam du dgongs pa las kaṃ po rdo rje dpal brtsegs bsu ba la byung ba gzhu'i lhas bkag bas ma khegs gsungs/

de tsam na rje sgom pa lha lung na grwa pa sum brgya tsam dang bcas te bzhugs pa la/ rta khrab 'ga' bsnams nas khams su gshegs pa'i phyi phyag la byon/ rje sgom pa'i zhal nas kho bo yang gnas nang du 'gro snyam pa yin pa la rkang pa na bas ma brtol/ bla ma'i bka' yin pas khyed rang lan cig song*/ 'tsho ba ye ma rnyed pa'am g.yeng ba ches nas dge sbyor ma smar na yar shog /kho bo ni yun ring por mi sdod de 'chi ba yin gsungs/ der rje btsun gyis bshums pas/ ma ngu bla bo bshad kyis nyon do gsung nas/ sngar sgrub pa ji ltar mdzad pa dang*/ da lta chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur mkhyen rdo rje gdan la sogs pa'i gnas khyad par can rnams skad cig gcig gis gzigs par nus pa la sogs pa'i gsung gleng ngo mtshar can mang po byon pas shin tu spro ba byung gsungs/ de nas rdzi mgo'i tshong dpon rin chen dpal gyis gdan 'dren byas nas byon pa las/ 'phan yul du phebs tsam na tre bo rnams kyis 'byon du ma ster/ de'i dus su bla ma phag mo gru pas btsun pa ye shes 'od la 'phrin bskur te/ khyed khams su ma 'byon/ gal te 'byon na yang dbang bskur dang rab gnas mang po ma mdzad/ sku tshe la bar chad byung dogs yod ces gsungs pa las/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khong nga la thugs brtse ba yin te/ kho bo bzhon lnga med par 'brog tu mi 'gro/ de tsam gyis yid ches med par dbang bskur dang rab gnas mi byed/ dbang bskur yang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ ma bskur yang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi/ rje btsun chen po mi la'i sku tshe tsam zhig thub pa yin/ de la blo bur ba mi 'ong gsungs/ der tshur log nas mtshur ngos bzangs su bzhugs pa de'i dus su sku las ring bsrel dpag tu med pa byon/ sku chab bdud rtsi thams cad kyang ring bsrel du gyur/ khyad par du tshems byon pa la/ tshems gcig pu de tshems chung mang po gyur/ ci zhig ltar na de rnams ring bsrel du gyur/

de yang ring bsrel gyi dbyibs mchod rten dang sā ts+tsha dang*/ rdo rje la sogs pa'i gzugs su grub pa dpag tu med pa byon pa rnams/ dad pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis phyogs phyogs rnams su gdan drangs/ rje sgom tshul bzhed gsungs nas ring bsrel dad rten du phul/ shin tu dgyes par byung gsungs/ khyad par du dpal he ru ka dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ jo bo kha sar pa ṇa dang gsum gyi sku rgyu ring bsrel las grub pa byon pa'i kha sar pa ṇa'i sku de 'khrid pa gnas brtan la phul/ rje btsun ma'i sku de jo sras rdo rje 'od la gnang*/ dpal he ru ka'i sku de rnal 'byor pa gcig la byin gsungs/ spyir ring bsrel gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'phel ba dang*/ gshegs pa 'ga' re byung*/ dbyibs dang kha dog 'gyur ba shin tu mang*/ dang po byon pa nas 'phos shing byon pa dang*/ mngon sum du 'phar zhing lding ba la sogs sna tshogs pas dang po the tshom yod pa rnams kyang phyis the tshom chod de mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob par gyur to// yang kol ti ba'i mgron po go btsun yon bdag gis gdan 'dren byas nas 'phan yul du byon pa'ang tre po'i mgron po gshegs su ma ster/ gzhu+u la tshur log nas slob dpon sgom pa snying po se ru+u na bzhugs pa la rta bzang po dang 'bul ba 'ga' khyer nas phyag la byon/ de nas tre bo'i mgron po rgya a skyabs ces bya ba'i gdan 'dren byas nas dgung lo lnga bcu pa la khams su byon/ spyir dbus phyogs su lo bcu thos bsams dang*/ lo bcu gnyis sgrub pa mdzad/ gru bzhir lo brgyad bzhugs pa bcas lo sum bcu song ngo*// de nas byang lam na mar byon pa'i tshe nub gcig rnal lam du bud med tshon mo zhig gi ro rnyed pa bshas pas rtsib ma'i rtsa ba nas ḍa ma ru mang po byung*/ de rnams kyang sgra rang grag tu sgrog cing nam mkha' la song*/ rje btsun gyis kyang de rnams dang 'grogs te byon pas u rgyan sprul ba'i zhing du phebs de na ḍā ki ma'i sde tshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dug pa la/

bud med cig na re 'di yan chad ni ye shes kyi ḍā ki ma'i gling yin/ 'di man chad 'jig rten gyi ḍā ki ma rnams kyi gling yin zhes gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa mang du gsan no// de nas zla stod kyi mkhar gsar du lo gnyis bzhugs/ skal ldan mang po byang chub kyi lam la bkod/ rje sgom tshul la 'bul ba yang bskur/ de nas trer byon lo gnyis su bzhugs/ dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga la kaṃ po gnas nang du phebs te yun ring du bzhugs/ rnal lam sngar nas rtsal 'byongs kyang*/ gnas nang du phebs ma thag nas/ rnal 'od gsal 'ba' zhig tu song*/ 'od gsal nyin mtshan 'khor yug rgyun chad med pa de de nas byung*/ chos rje sgam po pas de mkhyen nas lung bstan pa yin par gda'/ bka' bzhin bsgrubs pa'i byin rlabs kyang yin te 'ong gsungs/ der skal ldan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i don mdzad sgom chen rtogs ldan mang po'ang byung*/ gnas nang du phebs nas lo lnga na ja mdzo lnga bcu la sogs pa gdan sar 'bul ba bskur/ der bzhugs pa'i tshe lha tshogs mang po'i zhal gzigs shing*/ khyad par du dgyes rdor lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ dgyes rdor lhan skyes dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dbu stong spyan stong dpa' mo sum bcu so drug gis bskor ba dang*/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ mi g.yo ba dang*/ sgrol ma sngon mo zhal sbyor dang*/ 'jam dpal dgra nag gi lha tshogs dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi lha tshogs dang*/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa lha dgu yab yum zhal sbyor gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ ma hā mā yā lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor sogs zhal gzigs shing*/ dgyes mdzad lha dgu'i bstod pa dang*/ bar do'i gdams pa sogs rjes su bstan pa mang po dang*/ rdo rje sgra brnyan dpag tu med pa gsan to/ /yang sngo rur ā li kā li dkar dmar gyi yi ge'i phreng ba dang*/

sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge nam mkha' la gsal bar gzigs/ de nyid kyi dus su thugs nyams khyad par can yang byung gsungs/ yang pom phug bzhugs pa'i dus ri bo ma ṇi bha ga la'i snang ba byung*/ de yang sprin dang na bun 'thibs pa'i gseb na bya dang gcan gzan rigs mi gcig pa sna tshogs yod pa'i rtse la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku gcer bu skra grol ba bde ba'i nyams can thod pa dang gri gug badzin pa/ phyag g.yon pa'i gru khug du zhabs g.yas bcug par rgyan spangs pa'i mkha' spyod ma'i zhal gzigs so// yang dus gcig gi tshe ston zla ra ba'i nya la chos rje'i 'das mchod byas pa'i dus su/ nyi ma phyed yol nas nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon gdugs dang dkyil 'khor lta bu byung ba'i dkyil na bla ma lha rje g.yas g.yon na nye gnas legs mdzes dang*/ grags mdzes gnyis kyis mtha' rten gtso 'khor du bzhugs pa'i zhal nas/ bu gnyis su med pa lta ba'i don// yengs su med pa sgom pa'i don// zung du 'jug pa spyod pa'i don// de gsum dbyer med 'bras bu'i don// zhes gsungs pa gsan no// yang gnas nang du bzhugs pa'i tshe sing ga la'i gling du rdzu+u 'phrul gyis byon te/ dur khrod gcig tu slob dpon chen po rdo rje dril bu pa dang mjal/ gsol ba btab pas thebs shing gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa mang po thob gsungs/ yang gnas nang du nub gcig gi rmang lam na dge slong sham thabs dkar po can cig byung nas sangs rgyas la chos mnyan du 'gro'am zer/ thugs dgongs la sangs rgyas mar me mdzad dang*/ shākya thub pa ni mya ngan 'das/ mgon po byams pa yin nam dgongs nas dris pas yin zer te/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na phar byon pas 'od zer de ltem ltem byed pa byung gsungs/ der dga' ldan du byon pas dgon po byams pa rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha byad kyis dge slong dkar po sha stag la chos gsung gin 'dug ste/

'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bsnan par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag blta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes gsungs pa gsan/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'ang zhus gsungs/ yang gnas nang du brag brtsegs pa brgya'i steng na bla ma sku bde ba'i nyams kyis bzhugs pa la/ mkha' 'gro ma rus pa'i rgyan can brgyad kyis me tog gi phreng ba phyag tu phul ba de rnams nam mkha' la gtor bas rin po che pad+ma brtsegs pa'i khang par gyur to// yang gnas nang du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'de chung sangs rgyas lho stod du ldom bu la song bas/ bla ma'i gdan sa dwags lha sgam po zhig pa thos te byung ba la/ rin po che bas dgongs pa btang nas gzigs pas/ dang po dwags po gsal de nas bal yul tshun chad gsal/ de nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad gsal ba las/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mang por sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mang po sras du ma dang bcas pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gzigs te/ gdan sa zhig par mi bden par 'dug gsungs/ de ji ltar lags zhus pas/ ngas da lta rang bltas pas mthong gsungs/ yang gnas nang du bzhugs pa'i tshe rnal lam chos thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam tsam du gzigs pa'i ngang nas bla ma lha rje rin po che dang mjal mngon dga'i 'pho ba gyis gsungs/ der rje btsun gyis kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor sgyu ma tsam du sprul nas/ lha rje nyid kyang kyai rdo rje lha dgur mdzad de nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i thugs kar bstim par mdzad/ gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad kyang*/ dzaḥzhes bla ma nyid kyi sku la bsdus nam mkha' la yal bar mdzad pas bla ma lha rje shin tu dgyes te mthun gyur gnang gsungs/ yang gnas nang du bzhugs pa'i tshe rmang lam du rgya gar gyi ri gser gyi bya skyibs can zhes bya ba na/ bla ma lha rje sku dngos su bzhugs pa dang mjal/ bla ma brdzus skyes lags sam zhus pas/

mngal skyes yin brdzus skyes kyis sems can gyi don mi 'ong gsungs/ slob dpon yod lags sam zhus pas/ gnyug ma rgyun chad med pa la slob dpon mi dgos par gda' gsungs/ yang dag pa'i gdams pa zhus pas/ skyes pa'i yul de spangs na chags sdang bral bar nges// tshul khrims don dang ldan na bde 'gro thob par nges// thabs la nan tan byas na lam de chod par nges// ma bcos rang sar bzhag na don de rtogs par nges// zhes gsungs pa gsan no// yang gnas nang du slob dpon sgom pa'i 'das mchod cig gi mthar/ dag snang la rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs ma he rgyu ba'i tshal du byon pas rje sgom tshul dang mjal/ khyed la 'dir 'ong ba'i nus pa yod ang gsung zhing ngo mtshar gyi gleng slong dang*/ gdams ngag mang po gsungs so/ /'di skabs shed du/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i bdag po kaḥ rin po che dam pa bde gshegs kyis mjal te/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi dbang bskur dang gdams pa mang po gsungs/ yang nub cig rnal lam du mtsho chen po zhig gi dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po chen po skyes pa'i steng na rje btsun nyid bzhugs pa la/ gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis pi wang sbrengs/ nub cig gi phyogs na bde ba can/ zhes spyan 'dren pa rmis/ de 'chi ltas yin par 'dug ste bzlog pa la tshegs ma byung gsungs/ de'i tshe dgung lo drug cu rtsa bdun bzhes te/ sku khams cung zad ma snyom pa la dge 'dun rnams kyis gsol 'debs tshogs gsog mang du byas shing*/ bla ma stag del ba la sogs pa'i grā pa rgan pa bcus drung nyid du sku rim sgrub par zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyed rnams kyi bsams pa la kho bo 'chi snyam te/ kho bo da lta mi 'chi/ bla ma mi la'i sku tshe tsam zhig thub pa yin/ 'on kyang tshogs sogs ni byas pas chog /ces g.yu bdun la sogs pa'i tshogs sogs mdzad/ sku khams kyang dngas par gyur te/
yon tan dgon pa bas lha lung gi rab gnas zhus te byon pa'i lam khar/ dpal lha mo la sogs chos skyong srung ma sprin gyi phung po lta bu zhal gzigs so//

de nas rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi'i tshe nam mkha' la ḍā ma ru dang*/ ā li kā li'i sgra mang po gsan te yar gziḍa pas/ lha tshogs dpag tu med pa'i zhal nas chos gsungs pa/ lta sgom nam mkha' chu dang mtshungs// spyod pa dgag med sgrub tu med// de gsum dbyer med gnyug ma yin// kun rdzob pi wang sgra dang mtshungs// de don de nyid dbyer med yin// zhes gsan/ me tog gi nas rten la rang 'thor ba song ste thams cad ngo mtshar ba skyes te bkra shis par gyur to/ /gnas nang gi lho phyogs nyi ma bzhi tsam gyis na/ dge bshes shākya zhes bya ba/ bal po hang du dkar po'i slob ma/ nā ro pa'i yang slob rnal 'byor pa zhig gis gdan drangs nas rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ skye bo pho mo thag ring ba rnams kyis lha khang me 'bar ba mthong*/ thag nye ba kun gyis lha khang 'khor ba mthong*/ nang na yod pa'i yon bdag kun gyis rten rnams 'gul ba dang*/ sgra grags pa la sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung ba mthong*/ khyad par du rdo rje sems dpa'i lugs sku chen po zhig gi phyag mtshan gyi rdo rje/ sngar lugs kyi dus nas shin tu yo bar gyur/ sus kyang bsrang bar ma nus pa la rin po che bas lta stangs mdzad pa tsam gyis drangs por gyur bas thams cad ngo mtshar gyur to// yang 'jam yul khang dkar zhes bya bar/ smad dge jo sras kyis gdan drangs rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas pa'i skabs su me tog gi nas rnams khol zhing rang mthor du song nas rten rnams la phog cing me tog gi snod nam mkha' la chags pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur cing*/ dge bshes des rin po che ba la pha rol tu phyin pa'i sa lam dang sbyar bas bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu pa gcig gis bstod do// yang bla ma nyid kyi sku 'bag cig dang*/ dgyes rdor gyi dkyil 'khor zhig la rab gnas mdzad pa'i dus su/ rten 'brel snying po bzlas pa'i skabs su bla ma'i zhal nas sgrol ma'i bstod pa gyis gsung*/

phyis de ci lags zhus pas de'i tshe sgrol ma lha dgu byon nas thang ka la thim gsungs so/ /yang gnas nang du bzhugs pa'i tshe ri chen po zhig gi steng du sprin nag po zhig byung ba'i gseb na gri gug gi 'tshubs ma chen po'i dbus su chos skyong mgon po gri gug ma'i zhal gzigs so/ /yang gnas nang na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ lan cig sngon gyi bram ze chen po la sogs pa dang*/ rje mi la dang*/ bla ma lha rje la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams tshogs 'khor lhan cig mdzad pa la 'dzom nas mjal/ gdams pa'i bka' stsal mang po'ang thob ces gsung*/ yang kha che grong khyer krig bstan gzigs par bzhed nas/ sku brgya stong du mar sprul nas ngang pa dang*/ seng ge la sogs pa'i khri'i steng du bzhugs te byon pas/ skye ba med pa'i sgra rnyan mang po gsan gsung*/ lan cig rgya nag gtong kun gzigs pa la byon nas se tshang mkhar du pheb tsa na dge bshes shes rab bla ma phyug po zhig gi bur skyes 'dug /'dis kho bo ngo shes sam mi shes snyam du dgongs pa'i tshe/ kho dgod pa la sogs pa dga' ba'i rtags 'dug ste/ shes par byung gsungs/ rgya nag gtong kun gyi bkod pa yang gsal bar gzigs so// yang gnas nang du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dgongs mo rgyun gtor btang ba'i rjes la nye gnas smon lam bla ma dang gsung gleng mdzad cing bzhugs pa/ steng thog tu 'od dmar po chen po zhig snang byung*/ de'i tshe dgongs pa cung zad mi gsal bar gyur nas nye gnas mi'i ming dri ba'i tshul mdzad de/ btsun chung lags sde pa 'di'i ming dang*/ 'di'i mkhan po'i ming ci yin gsungs/ 'di'i ming grags pa shes rab/ mkhan po'i ming brtson 'grus shes rab bgyi pa lags shes zhus pa dang*/ dgongs pa ltar gsal bar gyur te/ rā hu la 'grim pa'i grib tu 'dug ste gnod par ma nus gsungs so// yang gnas nang du sgom chen zhig gis rin po che rdo rje rnal 'byor mar mthong*/

dbang bskur zhig gi dus dge bshes shig gi kyang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar mthong ste grogs po la bstan pas des kyang mthong*/ 'dzam ston sangs rgyas bya bas tshogs gral du bla ma bde mchog he ru kar mthong*/ dbus pa sgom chen zhig gis rin po che thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong sku mdog ser po rtsa ba'i zhal bla ma nyid kyi skur bzhugs pa zhig tu mthong nas nam ma langs bar du phyag btsal bas sgom chen pa de bsod nams skyes te/ bla ma bsam yas pa bya bar grags/ gangs kyi chu 'dis lba ba yong na dbus su 'gro ran pa 'dra zhes gsungs pas/ de nub dge bsnyen rdo rje dpal brtsegs mi dkar rta dkar can thal mo sbyar te/ 'gyur chu'i sman sdum brgyad po 'dis phan zer zhing*/ dus rtag tu bzhud dgos mi gsung bar zhu/ blo mi bde bar 'dug zer te song*/ phyis bzhud par brtsams pas rlung thog chen pos thang shing bsgyel/ dre'u thang gi pha wang mang po gas pa la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul mang po bstan/ de ltar yun ring du bzhugs shing skal ldan bsam gyis mi khyab pa smin par mdzad/ ka brag gi dge bshes tshul khrims mchog gis/ a tsa ra zhig rgya gar nas tong kun du mar song nas sa skyar yar 'ongs pas rgya yig zhig khyer nas 'di bla ma de la phul zer ba'i yi ge zhig dang*/ khong rang gi phrin yig la/ bla ma thang gcig trer byon/ nga dang ni mjal te mi 'ong*/ cis kyang 'byon par zhu zer ba zhig bcas btsun pa zhig la bskur nas chos rje'i phyag tu phul bas/ rgya yig 'di'i don ngas shes gsungs/ de nas dgung lo bdun cu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa la/ dge 'dun rnams kyis ji ltar bshol yang ma gsan par kam po gnas nang nas gdan btegs 'bri klung la byon/ sbas yul du dge bshes gyang skya pa la sogs smin par mdzad de/ sab tir rgyun bzhugs mdzad/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das dpal bde mchog lha lnga'i zhal gzigs so/

/'dzam yul pom phug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ btsun pa zhig gis bla ma jo bo yi ge drug par mthong ste/ 'dzam tsa na sgom bzang zhes grags pa byung*/ gzhan zhig gis kyang bla ma rin po che bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa seng ge'i khri la bzhugs nas chos gsungs pa'i snang ba byung*/ de la sogs pa zad pa med de/ slar byon nas ldong dgrar dbyar bzhugs mdzad/ 'bri dam pa chos phyug gi dge 'dun thams cad der 'dus te smin grol gyi lam la bkod/ 'bri klung spyi bar du bzhugs pa'i dus su sku chab bsil ba'i 'dam/ mi gnyis kyis gdan drangs pa las/ 'dam nang na ring bsrel yod zer ba'i rmi lam byung ste/ phyir nang 'dam pa chu sig byas pas ring bsrel bzhi byon/ de'i gtam rgyud gsan te mi de gnyis khrid la shog gsungs nas/ gdams pa bstan pas dge sbyor bzang po yang dag pa byung*/ yang trer byon zla ba bco brgyad bzhugs/ 'khrugs pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis zhi/ dge 'dun 'tshogs pa stong phrag re tsam 'dus shing thams cad smin grol la bkod/ sgam por g.yu chen bdun dang*/ ja mdzo bdun cu la sogs pa'i 'bul ba bskur/ de nas gle du karmar byon te/ dgon pa btab mi mthun pa rnams bsdums/ btson thams cad bkrol/ sgam por gser 'bum dang g.yu dngul gyi 'bul ba mdzad/ de'i tshe ldan ma sgom chen gyis karma'i yang dgon du phyag 'tshal du phyin pas/ rin po che gzims mal na/ mchod rten dkar po shin tu mdzes pa cig 'dug par mthong*/ yang zla stod mkhar du byon rab gnas mdzad pas/ gdung rten chen po zhig gi bum pa la bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i sku gcig dang*/ bla ma nyid kyi sku zhig 'bur du dod par rang byon du byon pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ khyad par du cham phu ba dpon rin dad pa skyes nas bsgoms pas/ sgom bzang po yang dag pa byung*/ spyir yang gzhan snang du me tog rten la rang 'thor du song ba dang*/

rten g.yo zhing 'gul ba dang*/ 'od dang sgra byung ba la sogs pa brjod kyis mi lang*/ gzhan yang zhwa bo dang sgur po la sogs pa la phyag gis reg pa tsam gyis drangs por gyur cing 'gro 'dug nus pa dang*/ long ba dang lkug pa la sogs la'ang byin rlabs mdzad pas mig gsal zhing smra shes mkhas par gyur pa dang*/ mi ma yin pa la bden pa brjod pa tsam gyis phrin las sgrub pa ni brjod kyis mi langs te bsam gyis mi khyab bo// rten 'dre can brgya la rab gnas byed pa dang*/ mdze po dang nyams pa can brgya la dbang bskur yang sku grib mi 'byung bar gda' ba rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ gnyis 'dzin gyi blo dang bral zhing chos thams cad du ma ro gcig tu rtogs nas gnyug ma rgyun chad med pa'i ngang la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa la/ dngos por 'dzin pa'i grib 'byung ba'i yul med gsungs/ de'i dus rtsa spyil ba'i grwa pa rnams kyis dbang zhus te/ bla ma lha bya ba zhig gis rin po che nub dang po la rdo rje 'chang du mthong*/ gnyis pa la rdo rje rnal 'byor mar mthong*/ gsum pa la rje btsun til+li par mthong*/ 'bri lce bar du/ dge 'dun mang po gral mdzad pa'i dbu la rin po che bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sngags pa zhig gis phyag 'tshal bar 'dod pa la rin po che pa ma mthong*/ nye gnas kun gyis bstan kyang ma mthong*/ jo bo byang chub kyis bstan kyang ma mthong nas/ jo bo byang chub yi mug ste spyan chab phyung*/ dge 'dun yon mchod thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ sa mdo na bka' gdams pa zhig gis stag lpags gcig thogs te mjal du 'ongs pas yun rings por ma mthong*/ gnas nang gi shar phyogs nyi ma bzhi'i sa nas 'dzam ston sangs rgyas/ bla ma mjal bar 'dod pa skyos pas de'i mod la rin po che pa zhabs rjen du byon phyag btsal/ byin rlabs zhus bsnyun dris te gdan bshams pas bla ma mi snang bar gyur to/ /yang sa thag ring po nas slob ma zhig nad kyi zug rngus gdungs te/

bla ma la gsol ba btab pas byon te byin rlabs mdzad/ nad kyi sdug bsngal zhi ste bla ma de nyid du ma dmigs so/ /'bri klung gi ldong nga 'dra bzhugs dus/ trer ga stag gi sar dben pa sgom chen zhig gis gsol ba btab par byon nas chos gsung ste 'ja' bzhin du yal/ de nas 'gro don mdzad cing lho brgyud la lam phyung nas yul dbus su byon/ rje 'jig rten mgon po sgam por bzhugs pas/ bla ma rin po che'i gdan sa nged tsha bos 'dzin dgos pa'i skabs byung*/ bu chen gyi nang na nyid las lhag pa ma mchis pas/ nged rnams kyi mgon du pheb dgos ces gsol ba btab kyang ma phebs par lam 'bri khung thel brgyud pas/ rje 'jig rten mgon pos 'bam thang nas bsu ba mdzad/ chos gsan zhing thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ khyed 'gro mgon klu sgrub yin zhes bla ma rin po ches lung bstan/ sgam por gser 'bum tshar bzhi/ mdo mang tshar gcig /gser gyi glegs bam brgya dang bcu/ g.yu chen bcu/ mdzo rta lnga bcu la sogs pa'i 'bul ba mdzad/ jo bo yi ge drug pa dang*/ shākya mu nes gtso mdzad dbus gtsang gi sde dgon rnams su+u rta bdun cu la sogs pa nor chen brgya lhag gi tshogs sogs mdzad/ spyir kho bo dbus su 'ongs pa la dgos pa bzhi yod/ rje sgom pas khyed khams su skyid sdug gang byung yang dbus su yar shog gsungs pa'i bka' sgrub pa dang*/ gdan sar gser chos brgya 'bul byed pa dang*/ zhang tshal pa sgom chen pa 'khrugs pa mdzad pa 'di/ rna bar ma snyan pas bshol 'debs pa dang*/ gzhu mtshur gyi bar du dgon pa cig bya snyam pa ste don bzhi la 'ongs gsungs nas tshal du byon/ 'khrugs pa bsdums pas/ bla ma zhang gi rin po che la dag snang mtha' yas pa gzigs te/ phyag nas 'jus te bro brdungs/ phyis sku ma 'das kyi bar du 'khrugs pa ma mdzad/ dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa'i sa mo bya'i lor/ mtshur phu'i mchod khang gong bzhengs par mdzad/

zhang rin po ches kyang mchod khang gong gi ka ru mar gdugs khams gsum zil gnon sogs sna gsum phul/ mtshur lha lung du byon te bzhugs pa las bcom ldan 'das yi ge drug pa zhal gzigs so// yang de nyid du/ mdang rgya gar gyi dur khrod zhig tu rgya gar gyi sgrub thob rnal 'byor pa 'ga' dang tshogs 'khor byas pa rmis gsung ngo*/ /de dang dus mtshungs par gtsang la stod thang chung zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang na ston pa cig thang pa drubs kyin yod tsa na/ a tsa ra ras kyang gon pa lag na thod pa thogs pa gsum dang*/ bod kyi rnal 'byor pa zhabs rjen na bza' ras rkyang dang*/ phyag na thod pa dang sba'i ber ma lcag thogs pa/ dung gi rna rgyan yod pa lo bcu drug tsam lon pa cig dang bzhi byon/ bod kyi rnal 'byor pa de dang ston pa gnyis gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ khyed gang nas byon dris pas/ rnal 'byor pa de'i zhal nas nged rdo rje gdan nas 'ongs/ kha che dang pu hrang na tshur la lam phyung nas 'ong gsungs/ rgya gar du ci la byon zhus pas/ rdo rje gdan gyi dus mchod la phyin gsungs/ 'o na bya lo'i dus mchod la grub thob mang po 'byon pa yin zer ba khyed dang mjal lam zhus pas/ rnal 'byor pa de'i zhal nas/ rgya gar lho phyogs dzā lan+dhara'i rgyal po zla ba rnam par gnon pas/ ha ha sgrog pa'i dur khrod du tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor bar 'dod nas grub thob mngon par shes pa mnga' shing rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa pho mo rnams la gsol ba btab pas/ rgya gar nas bzhi 'byon/ bod kyi gnyis dang drug 'byon gsungs/ de rnams su lags zhus pas/ in+d+ra bud+dhi/ nag po spyod pa/ dza lan+dha ra/ shing lo pa dang bzhi rgya gar ba yin/ bod kyi gnyis ni dharma kīrti dang*/ dharma shī la yin gsungs/ de gnyis gang lags zhus pas/ dharma shī la ni chos kyi tshul khrims bya ba yin te 'chi med grub pa'i gdams ngag yod/ da lta mnga' ris kyi stod na lha khang cig mdzad/

de la brten nas gzhan don sgrub/ shrī dharma kīrti ni dpal chos kyi grags pa zhes bya ba lam rtsa dang rlung bsten nas phyag rgya chen po lam cig chod kyi gdams ngag yod de/ bod yul gyi smad na bzhugs/ yongs su grags pa'i mtshan ni bla ma dbu se zhes bya ba yin/ nged kyang der 'gro gsungs/ der ston pa na re/ bla ma dbu se de sku snyan pa che bas nga yang der 'gro snyam pa la sku nas su byon te gshegs pa'i dus yin zer bas chos mi tshar gyis dogs nas lus pa lags zhus pas/ rnal 'byor pa de'i zhal nas/ ston pa khyed kyis bzang spyod smon lam yang ma gzigs sam/ gdul bya gang zhig gcig tsam gyi// don du thub pas bskal par bzhugs// de yang myur du smin mdzad de// drod bsher ldan pa'i myu gu bzhin// zhes bya ba lags mod/ gzhan don du gsol ba btab na sangs rgyas kyang bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag par bzhugs par bshad pas/ dad gus dang ma bral bar myur du song zhig dang chos tshar nas 'ong gsungs/ der dga' nas rnal 'byor pa de la gdams ngag zhus pas/ rnal 'byor pa de bzhengs nas a tsa ra gcig gi tsa na gro ga la yi ge bris te dril ba zhig blangs nas ston pa la gsungs/ dpe yang gnang*/ 'di rnam bzhi rgyud grol byin rlabs nus 'don gyi gdams pa shin tu zab mo yin pas mi la ma bstan par zung zhig dang*/ phyis kyang nga dang 'phrad nas 'ong gi gsung ste bzhud/ ston pas gra khang du phyin te chos ston 'dren par brtsams nas gdan 'dren du phyin tsam na/ dkor gnyer na re/ khyod rang song ba'i rjes de ka la rnal 'byor pa de rnams kyang song zer/ phyogs thams cad du dris pas kyang*/ mthong ba dang thos pa ma byung*/ der ston pa nges shes khyad par can skyes te dbus phyogs la byon pas/ khyi lo dbyar zla 'bring po la stod lung mtshur phu'i dgon par bla ma dang mjal/ ston khar song tsam na bla mas grwa pa rnams la sngar gyi lo rgyus thor ba gsung 'dug ste/

khong gi rnal 'byor pa bzhi po de 'dir byon nam ma byon zhu dgos snyam pa'i tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi de sang tsam na byas pas chog gi gsungs bas zhu ma spob/ da ni the tshom med pa zhig bya dgos snyam nas khams pa dpon grags seng gi khang par tshogs 'khor bshams/ rje rin po che dang*/ bla ma stag del ba dang*/ dge bshes dkon mchog seng ge dang*/ sgom pa tshul khrims rgyal po la sogs pa grwa pa bsgres po bcu tsam gdan drangs/ tshogs gral du sngar gyi de rnams gsung par zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ in+d+ra bud+dhi bar pa dang*/ shing lo pa dang*/ nag po spyod pa ba gsum yin/ khyed la chos bstan pa de nga yin/ gdams ngag de yang in+d+ra bud+dhi la zhus pa yin/ rgya gar gyi tshogs dpon nag po spyod pa bas mdzad/ khyod nga'i skye ba bzhi'i slob ma yin te/ da res dang lan lngar mjal/ chos nyan bshad kyang bzang po yin te/ da res nga dang ma 'phrad na bshad pa la 'byams 'gro bas the tshom gcod cing sgom la gzhug pa'i don du nga 'ongs pa yin gsungs/ bla ma stag del bas dge bshes gtsang po ba skye ba bzhi'i mjal lugs zhus pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas sngon rgya gar du mgar pa rat+na shrī zhes bya bar skye ba bzhes pa'i tshe/ kho bos byang chub mchog tu sems skyed pa'i slob ma yin gsungs/

yang de'i rjes la gling 'di'i byang phyogs de ba na zhes bya bar skyes ba'i dus/ kho bo'i mkhan bu yin gsungs/ de nas lus 'phags por me tog pa shes rab bzang po zhes bya bar skyes/ de'i dus su kho bo la chos drug pradzña'i gdams ngag bya ba nyan gsungs/ de nas skye ba 'di'i gong mar mtha' 'khob rgya mtsho'i 'gram du/ bram ze rgyal ba shes rab ces bya bar skyes pa la/ kho bos dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ de dus 'di bstan bcos la shin tu mkhas/ sgom pa la yang bag chags bzhag pas/ da lta sgom la nges shes skye sla ba byung pa yin gsungs/ yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma pa'i lus kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa gzigs gsungs/ de ji ltar lags zhus pas/ rgyal gyi gnas brtan 'dre chung pa de sprul pa gsum gyis sems can gyi don byed dngos rgyal gyi de yin/ sprul pa ni rgya gar na yod/ yang sprul rgya gar dang bal po'i bar na yod/ de dpal phag tshang ba'i skye ba yin/ sngon thog mtha' med pa'i dus nas kho bo'i slob ma yin gsungs/ yang rin po che'i zhal nas mi nyag gi rgyal po de kha cig dge ba'i bshes gnyen glang ri thang pa'i skye bar byed de de ma yin/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ma taṃ gi pa'i skye ba yin gsungs/ rgyal po skye pa'i dgos pa ni yab rgyal po la phan 'dogs pa dang*/ rgyal khams kyi sems can rnams bsod nams kyi las la 'god pa dang*/ rgyal po btsan pas btson mang po bkrol ba rnams ma 'ongs pa'i dus na gdul byar 'gyur ba la dgongs pa yin/ rgyal po de dang yang kho bo 'brel pa shin tu zab/ dge bshes gtsang po ba khyed mi nyag gi rgyal khams su bzhud la ri bo ha la shan du bsgom dang*/ de na ḍā ki ma gser gyi mche ba can bya ba yod/ des khyod kyi phrin las thams cad bsgrub par 'gyur/ sems can mang po la phan thogs par 'dug gsungs/

mtshur phur bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nub gcig gi rmang lam na mnga' ris nas pu hrang du byon te/ mtha' 'khob bud+dha na zhes bya bar sleb pas/ de na rnal 'byor pa dpon slob gnyis dang phrad/ su yin dris pas/ in+d+ra bud+dhi yin zer/ gdams ngag zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rje btsun ma zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs las kha tshar dang bcas pa bstan/ yang mtshur phur bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rdo rje phag mo zhal bzhi ma yab dang bcas pa dpa' mo sum cu so drug gis bskor ba zhal gzigs te/ lha bzo zhang ston rdor po la zhal gzigs ji lta ba ri mor bris nas/ sgrub thabs gzhon nu la sbyin gsungs nas gnang ngo*// yang sgrub thabs de'i byin rlabs mang du mdzad cing gzhan la gsungs pas/ nub gcig gi rmang lam na/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pa'i dbus na/ bu mo gos dmar mo gon/ thod dmar po bcings shing rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ 'khor bzhis bskor ba cig gi zhal nas/ zab mo'i don gar dgar dgar ma bshad gsung ba gzigs/ phyis zho 'phrang gi gnas su nyi shu lnga la chos 'di'i byin rlabs mdzad pa'i dus/ bye ru'i ri lta bu'i brag dmar po shing cung zad skyes pa'i logs la sngar gyi bu mo lnga po de cung zad khros pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas te 'dug /khyed su yin dris pas/ nga ni su yin ma shes na/ rgyal po'i bu mo lak+ṣ+mī yin/ zab mo'i don gar dgar dgar ma bshad gsungs/ yang nyi shu brgyad la bla ma khams pa lung pa la byin rlabs mdzad pa'i nub mo nam mkha' la sprin dkar po srab chal ba'i nang na sngar gyi bu mo lnga po de shin tu khros shing*/ zab mo'i don gar dgar dgar bshad mi nyan byas pas m-i nyan zer nas bzhud pa gzigs/ gdams pa 'di shin tu gnyan shing byin rlabs che bar 'dug gsungs/ de'i tshe tre bo sgom chen gcig nad kyis shin tu sdug bsngal nas bla ma la gsol ba btab pas/ de nyid du byon te zhabs dbang mdzad pa la/

phyag 'tshal bar brtsams pa la/ phyag 'tshal mi dgos da lan khyod la nad kyi bar chad mi 'ong gsungs nas 'ja' bzhin du yal lo/ /dge bshes sum pas dgyes rdor du mthong*/ slob dpon dbra ston gyis kha dog lngar re mos kyis mthong*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas kyis bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor ma zhal nas 'od zer 'phro zhing nam mkha' la bzhugs par mthong*/ phyis 'das nas kyang yang dang yang du mthong*/ gtsang pa tshul seng gis dbang bskur zhus pa'i tshe/ rin po che pa dgyer rdor zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par gyur pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po byung ste/ grwa pa rnams la 'od kyi sna zug par mthong*/ dge bshes shes rab seng ges rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar mthong*/ yang bla ma rin po che la spyir bla ma du tsam bzhugs zhus pas/ mtshan nyid dang sngags kyi slob dpon mang du bzhugs te/ khyad par grub pa thob nges pa'i bla ma dgu yod pa yin gsungs/ de rnams gang dang gang lags zhus pas/ bla ma lha rje rin po che dang*/ rje sgom tshul dang*/ mnga' bdag ras chung pa dang*/ grub thob rdzong pa dang*/ bla ma spen phug pa dang*/ dpal chen rga lo dang*/ bla ma a seng dang*/ bla ma bkran ba chen po dang*/ bla ma bai ro dang*/ yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i bla ma de dgu yin zhing*/ gzhan yang rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mtshan brjod par dka' ba mang du bzhugs gsungs/ bla ma de rnams dang gzhan yang bla ma rnams kyi sku skye ba bzhes tshul zhus pas/ rje btsun mar pa lho phyogs dpal gyi ri dang nye ba'i shrī na gara'i grong khyer du/ paṇ+ḍi ta zhig tu sku 'khrungs rnal 'byor par yang mdzad de 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa mdzad gsungs/ bla ma lha rje rin po che ni/ kha che dang rgya gar gnyis kyi bar kar+ṇa pa zhes bya ba'am/ grong khyer pad+ma can zhes bya bar zhi ba'i go cha zhes grags par sku 'khrungs/ res dge slong du mdzad/

res rnal 'byor par mdzad/ slob dpon chen po nag po spyod pa pa dang*/ bir wa pa bzhin du spyod pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad/ der da lta 'di'i slob ma bzhi bcu tsam skyes 'dug gsungs so// spyir bla ma lha rje la sprul pa gsum yod de/ gcig nub phyogs bde ba bkod pa'i zhing khams byang chub sems dpa' dri med grags pa zhes bya bar mtshan bzung nas sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/ yang shar phyogs mu tig brgyan pa zhes bya ba na byang chub sems dpa' dri med zla ba zhes bya bar gyur nas sems can mang po'i don mdzad/ grong khyer pad+ma can du gdos bcas yal nas rab 'byams stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams a sho ka zhes bya bar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa yin gsungs/ rje sgom pa ni/ rgya gar nub phyogs gnas nyer bzhi'i ya gyal kong ka zhes bya ba'i yul du sku 'khrungs/ mu stegs kyi rgyal po btul nas sems can mang po'i don mdzad gsungs/ mnga' bdag ras chung pa ni rgya gar dang bal po'i bar du rat+na su kha zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs/ spyod pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don mdzad/ grub chen rdzong pa ni kha che dang u rgyan gnyis kyi mtshams su sku 'khrungs/ sngar gyi phyag rgya mo de yang der skye ba gzung nas zhabs tog byed de/ spyod pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ bla ma spen phug pa ni la stod gtsang por dga' ba'i ye shes zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs/ bla ma dpal chen po ni byang phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams mu tig dra bas brgyan pa zhes bya ba na dpal gyi 'byung gnas sbas pa zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs/ sems can gyi don mdzad/ slob dpon kran pa ni cog ro 'bri 'tshams kyi srib ri na ye shes 'byung gnas grags pa zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs/ bla ma dngul chu bai ro ba de tong khun rgyal po'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ slob dpon phywa pa de kha che'i grong khyer krig bstan du paṇ+ḍi ta zhig tu sku 'khrungs/

mkhan po sa phug pa de/ rgya gar phyogs su sku 'khrungs nas sems can mang po la phan thogs gsungs/ slob dpon sha ba stag dur ba de 'dzam bu gling gi nub phyogs zad pa grong khyer bde ldan du grags pa mtha' yas shes bya bar sku 'khrungs/ sems can bye ba tsam gyi don mdzad/ dge bshes zhu don mo ri pa de 'dzam bu'i gling zad pa'i mthar ri bo po ta la'i 'dab na chos brda'i sgo nas gsung ba zhig tu sku 'khrungs/ slob dpon pa tshab lo tswa ba de kha che'i grong khyer krig bstan gyi pha rol na paṇ+ḍi ta rin chen 'byung gnas shes bya bar sku 'khrungs nas 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad/ slob dpon shes rab byang chub ri bo bya rkang gi zhol du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgyad nas rab tu byung ste/ deng sang sgrub pa mdzad/ slob dpon shes rab rdo rje de 'phan yul rong du sku 'khrungs/ bka' gdams pa bstan nas sgrub pa mdzad/ slob dpon 'phags pa ston chos de bal yul pham mthing du rnal 'byor pa zhig tu sku 'khrungs nas phyag rgya ma cig dang ldom bu byed/ yang chos rje'i 'das mchod cig gi dus su/ bla ma lha rje'i slob ma bzhis sems can gyi don rlabs po che byed pa mthong nas gad mo cig shor/ dge bshes shes rab 'bum gyis de ci yin dris pa la/ nub phyogs na gser sgom ye shes snying po dang*/ ya zi sngon mo/ shar gyi phyogs na byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa byed pa cig tu skyes 'dug gsungs/ shar phyogs na sgom pa zhi mdzes dang*/ dwags po phag sgom bzhi po des sems can mang po'i don byed gsungs/ yang bla ma lha rje rin po che'i slob ma snga shos dge tshul cig da lta lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten rgyal bu bde spyod bzang po'i grong na byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa byed pa gcig tu skyes 'dug gsungs/ yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas smon lam bla ma khyod 'di nas tshe 'phos te/

nub phyogs pad+ma can du mkhan po mnga' ris pa tshe'i rig 'dzin thob pa de'i mkhan bur 'gyur/ sngon yang skye ba bzhir pad+ma can du mkhan slob kyi 'brel pa thob/ da lta 'di dang khyod skye ba lngar/ bar ma chad par rab tu byung gsungs/ yang gru bzhi dgon du bzhugs pa'i dus su slob ma sgom chen cig shi ba la rin po che ba'i zhal nas/ sgom pa de mdo khams smad 'dzam yul gyi sa char skyes 'dug gsungs/ phyis 'dzam yul du byon pa'i tshe/ khrom chen po'i gseb du byis pa gzhan las spobs pa che ba dad pa dang ldan pa cig byung ste/ sngar gyi sgom pa de'i skye ba de 'di yin gsungs/ sgom chen bzang po zhig byung ste 'dzam skye ba gsum pa zhes grags so// yang khams su bzhugs pa'i tshe/ zhal sngar btsun pa zhig shi ba gtsang rong du rab ston dar ma grags kyi bur skyes 'dug gsungs/ cang ma nam mkha' grags kyi nu bo shi ba de sum cu rtsa gsum na lha longs spyod can zhi gnas yod pa zhig tu skyes 'dug gsungs/ de lta bu'i mkhyen tshul ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ 'dir re re tsam bkod pa yin zhes rnam thar rnams su 'byung*/ spyir rje de nyid kyi sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i skyes rabs tshad med gzhal du med pa dag kyang gsal bar mkhyen cing*/ khyad par shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams baiḍūr+ya'i zhing zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs te/ dge slong gi tshul bzung nas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad do// yang lho 'dzam bu'i gling dang*/ nub ba lang spyod kyi bar na gling phran dha ri tha zhes bya ba yod de/ der sems can gyi don du sku 'khrungs/ de'i dus na bla ma lha rje rin po che rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug su ra ta pa zhes bya bar grags pas bla ma mdzad/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa cho ga lag len dang bcas pa zhus shing thugs nyams su bzhes so// yang 'dzam bu gling 'di'i rgya gar u rgyan gyi yul du zur dha ti zhes bya bar/

rnal 'byor pa u t+tiṣ+ṭha zhes bya ba mgar ba'i rigs su sku 'khrungs/ slob dpon med de rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor pa nus pa mchog tu gyur pa/ skal ldan rnams rdo rje theg pa'i lam la 'dren par mdzad do/ /yang nub ba lang spyod kyi gling du bram ze'i rigs su sku 'khrungs te/ dge slong dharma adhiṣ+ṭha gsang mtshan dharma shrī zhes bya ba rje btsun ti l+li pa la gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa zhus te sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /yang ba lang spyod kyi gling de nyid du mu stegs sdig spyod kyi rgyal po dar ma shī la zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mi mos shing sems can la gnod pa byed pa zhig yod pas 'dul ba'i don du/ rgyal po'i glang po che bdun brgya'i nang nas shin tu stobs che ba'i glang po zhig tu sku skye ba bzhes/ re zhig gi tshe rgyal po dmag gi dpung mang po dang bcas te phyin pa'i lam du sdig can rgyal po brdzis te bsad pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan pa dang*/ rgyal po ngan song du 'gro ba las zlog ste dge ba la bkod/ da lta'i yon bdag dgon pa ba 'di yin no gsungs/ yang rgya gar shar phyogs ka liṅka'i rgyal khams su sku 'khrungs te/ rgyal po zla bas rnam par gnon pa zhes bya bar gyur/ bla ma lha rje rin po che sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs shes bya bar gyur nas bla ma mdzad/ de'i slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen a ba dhū ti pa yin te/ da lta rje btsun mi lar grags/ de'i tshe rgyal po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten skor ba la byon pa'i lam du nam mkha' las sgra grags pa/ khyod da dung dngos grub mi thob ste/ rang gi gnas su song la 'dus byas kyi dge ba grub tshad gyis shig bya ba gsungs/ der rgyal pos dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa la sogs dge rtsa dpag tu med pa mdzad/ slar mchod rten bskor bas thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob/

slar 'byon dus khyi gnyis rjes la 'brangs pas kyang thun mong gi dngos grub thob/ da lta u rgyan gyi mkha' 'gro ma gzhan pas gdug rtsub che ba gnyis su gyur yod/ de dus kyi rgyal po'i 'khor dang ka liṅka'i mi mang po sa smad 'dir skyes yod de/ ston pa sangs rgyas dang*/ dge bshes rin chen rgyal mtshan gnyis la de dus thun mong gi dngos grub mang po yod pa la/ da lta med pa 'di de dus bsgrubs shing da lta ma bsgrubs pas len par 'dug /de'i tshe khyod bcu gsum gyis kho bo la gsol ba thebs te/ ston pa sangs rgyas dang*/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ yon tan 'od/ yon tan bla ma/ dge 'dun grags/ smon lam bla ma rnams dbus na yod la/ gcig tre na yod gsungs/ yang nub phyogs u rgyan du rje btsun til+li pa'i slob ma nus pa mchog tu gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pa shī la dan+ti zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs/ tshal dang nags 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs te/ de dus dbang bskur ba'i slob ma bzhi da lta 'dir yod de/ rdo rje 'bum/ sgom sngon/ shākya shes rab/ chos dpal rnams yin no gsungs/ yang 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i byang gi mtha' zad pa'i byang shar mtshams na/ chu klung me tog pad+mas brgyan pa zhes bya bar 'khrungs te/ dge slong dharma kīrti zhes bya/ mkhan po ni bram ze sadz+dza na zhes bya ba yin/ de dus kyi mkhan bu bzhi da lta yang 'dir dge bshes brtson 'grus shes rab dang*/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/ mdog mkhas pa/ mi dge jo sras rnams yin/ dge bshes phywa pa 'di paṇ+ḍi ta chung ngu zhig yin pa la kho bos slob dpon zhus/ dge bshes rdo rje seng ge 'di de dus phywa pa'i slob ma yin pa la/ da dung yang khong gi drung du skye bar 'dug gsungs/ de'i dus su slob dpon chen po ḍom+bi pa la ri bo bya skyibs su gsol ba thebs pa yin gsungs/

yang shar phyogs lus 'phags kyi gling du yab rgyal po dge ba bzang po dang*/ yum shes rab ma'i sras mo shes rab bzang mo zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs/ gsang mtshan mtsho skyes byang chub zhes bya/ rgyal bur skyes na rgyal srid 'dzin dgos shing sdig pa ngang gis 'phel ba la 'jigs nas sras mor skye ba gzung*/ yab yum dge ba la bkod de/ de'i dus su bla ma lha rje 'di dge slong dharma sid+dhi zhes bya bar bzhugs pa la sdom pa blangs/ yo byad mang po yod pa rnams bla ma la phul nas shin tu mnyes par byas/ chos kyang ci zhus zhus gnang ba yin gsungs/ de dus kyi kho bo'i grogs da lta 'dir/ dge 'dun 'od/ shes rab bla ma/ smon lam bla ma/ yon tan 'od/ ye shes 'od/ ye shes 'od zer/ gzhan zhig dang bdun/ pha dge ba grags/ ma dge ba bzang mo'i bu spun du gyur pa yin no gsungs/ yang shar lus 'phags dang*/ lho 'dzam bu gling gi bar na/ gling g.yog yongs su grags pa'i ming rat+na pha la zhes bya bar/ grong khyer rā dza pha la'am/ dharma pha la zhes par yab rje'u'i rigs dharma sbas pa dang*/ yum su ma ti'i sras su pa kīrti zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan rat+na shī la zhes bya/ de'i dus su bla ma lha rje 'di dpal gyi sbas pa zhes bya bar bzhugs pa la/ ma hā mā ya dang*/ sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs zhus/ de dus kho bo spyod pa nus pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin te/ lo brgya dang drug cu rtsa bzhi thub/ de dus kyi slob ma da lta 'dir/ yon tan 'od/ dge 'dun 'od/ ye shes bla ma/ smon lam bla ma/ 'byung gnas bla ma/ rgyal mtshan bla ma/ gtsang ston tshul seng*/ tre'i dge bshes dkon mchog dpal/ rdo rje shes rab/ bka' gdams pa gcig dang bcu la sgrol ma dang*/ dbang gi rab tu byed pa zhes bya ba'i chos bshad/ kho bos bla ma lha rje la tshogs 'khor gcig zhus pa'i tshe/

da lta'i slob ma khyed nyi shu tsam yod de/ dge bshes bka' gdams pa slob dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan/ ston pa sangs rgyas/ nye gnas gnyis/ dpon dge 'dun grags/ smon lam bla ma/ rdo rje shes rab/ dge bshes dkon mchog dpal/ ston pa tshul seng rnams dang*/ btsun pa gnyis kyang yod pa las/ gcig da dung 'di nyid na yod la/ gcig dbus su skyes/ yon bdag dgon pa ba 'di khyim bdag phyug po zhig gi bu yin pas yon bdag byas/ skye ba 'dir yang byas shing phyi mar yang byed/ mkhan po ka brag pas kho bo'i mkhan po skye ba gnyis su mdzad/ dge bshes sa nag pa dang*/ yul bar pa dang*/ gzhan zhig dang gsum la skyabs 'gro dang 'jug pa sems skyed bshad/ gcig gis bslab bya ma bsrungs pas da lta de nyid na skyes yod/ gcig mkhas pa chen po paṇ+ḍi ta cig yin pas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nyi shu pa bshad/ dge bshes bla ma 'od ni mdo smad du tshe tshang du skyes/ rgya nag gi 'gram yin te de na kho bo'i skye ba snga ma'i slob dpon cig yod/ grub thob zer nyan zhig gsungs/ yang bla ma rin po che nyid kyi ma 'ongs pa'i rnam pa thar pa'ang mang du gsungs ste/ rgya gar gi nub phyogs u rgyan nas nyin lam bcu gnyis kyi byang shar na kārti ka'i grong khyer na/ yab dharma sid+dhi dang*/ yum mahā pradzñā'i sras pradzña shī la zhes pa'i rnal 'byor par skye/ bla ma lha rje yang grong khyer pad+ma can na mngal la skyes pa'i mtshan zhi ba'i go cha zhes par skye/ de'i mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta cig gis shes bya'i bdag po byas/ bla ma lha rjes shes pa'i bdag po byas nas rtsod pas bla ma rgyal nas/ mu stegs pa de nang pa sangs rgyas par tshud nas ming dharma rā dzar btags nas/ mu stegs kyi rgyal po de'i ming ma hā dzi na yin/ grong khyer kārti ka na paṇ+ḍi ta bodhi badz+ra zhes pa nang na yon tan bzang po yod pa cig yod/ bla ma lha rje dang*/

dge slong sgom pa dang*/ zhi mdzes dang*/ gar ston dang*/ gser kong ye shes snying po dang*/ zom shi ye shes snying po dang*/ ya zi sngon mo dang*/ rgya che chung gnyis dang*/ grags mdzes dang*/ nyag sde ston pa dang*/ rog sgom dang*/ yon tan snying po ste/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa nus pa drug yod pas/ mu stegs kyi rgyal po rtog med kyi sgo nas btul ba dang*/ yul kārti ka'i rgyal po paṇ+ḍi tas btul ba gnyis dus gcig yin/ bla ma lha rje dang nang pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta dang mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta dang gsum ka rgyal po de'i mchod gnas yin/ grong khyer pad+ma can dang kārti ka gnyis kyi bar na grong nyung ba zhig yod de/ yul phyogs de thams cad mu stegs pa yin pa la/ ma lus pa nang pa sangs rgyas pa byas/ grong khyer de gnyis kyi mtshams na nyin lam gnyis tsam yod/ nga dang bla ma lha rje yang mjal/ yon bdag dgon pa ba yang de na blon po cig gi bur skyes nas rab byung byas/ khyed 'ga' yang grong khyer kar+ṇa par skye ste/ yon tan 'od dang*/ dge 'dun 'od dang*/ smon lam bla ma dang*/ ye shes 'od dang*/ ston pa tshul seng dang*/ dge 'dun grags/ khyed bdun lhan cig tu rje'u rigs su skye/ grong khyer de gsum yang phyogs gcig gi thabs su yod/ gzhan yang yul phyogs der slob dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan dang*/ ston pa sangs rgyas dang*/ ston pa byang chub grags dang*/ ston bsod dang*/ dpon dar ma rā dza dang*/ shākya shes rab dang*/ sgom sngon dang*/ rdo rje 'bum dang*/ dge bshes grags rin dang*/ dbang phyug grags dang*/ 'od zer bla ma dang*/ yon tan bla ma da nga*/ dar ma seng ge dang*/ rdo rje brtson 'grus dang*/ byang pa lha bzo la sogs pa khyed mang po bla ma lha rje dang mjal rgyu yin pa la ma mjal te/ skye ba phyi ma la mjal nas 'ong gsungs/ de'i rjes su bod yul dbus lho brag grub pa'i gnas bdun zhes par slob ma zhig gi don du skye ste yun ring por mi bzhugs/

khyed 'ga' re dang der 'phrad gsungs/ yang rgya gar lho phyogs u ru bi sha zhes par mkha' 'gro ma'i gnas kong bya ba yod pa der skye/ sa phyogs de na pa ta na zhes pa'i grong khyer du yon bdag dgon pa ba rgyal por skyes nas lam rnal ma la der sdod chug /khyed rnams dang yang der nga dang mjal nas gzod nga mi dgos pa mang po yang 'byung*/ 'gro ba gzhan mang po la phan par 'dug gsungs/ yang slob dpon dkon mchog seng ge la sogs pas/ bla ma rin po che mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i dus na 'khor gyi dang po gang dang gang lags zhus pas/ rgya gar lho phyogs lo ka bi ha ra'i gtsug lag khang na rnal 'byor pa mi tra dzo ki zhes bya ba cig yod pa de dang*/ yang mnga' ṛs kyi stod na sems can gyi don mang po mdzad pa'i dge slong dge ba'i blo gros shes bya ba zhig yod pa de dang*/ yang mi nyag chos kyi rgyal po'i bla ma rgya be bum ring mo zhes kyang zer/ rgya byang chub sems dpa' zhes kyang bya ba de dang*/ dge bshes dkon mchog seng ge khyod dang bzhi yin gsungs/ sangs rgyas pa'i mtshan mi gsung yang*/ zhang rin po che'i 'phrang po brag gi gter las shog dril ser po zhig byung bar/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i bla ma ni// mtshan ni dharma kīrti yin// byams pa'i bstan pa'i rjes thogs su// sangs rgyas seng ge zhes bya bar// bstan pa rab tu rgyas par 'gyur// dharma kī rti nyid yin no// 'di nas tshe 'phos phyi ma la// kārti ka yi rgyal khams su// khri phrag drug dang stong tsho drug/ the tshom med par shes par gyis// zhes lung bstan/ yang mtshur phur bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rmang lam na rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i zhol/ shing sna tshogs kyi tshal gtsug lag khang mang po yod pa'i sar byon pas/ bla ma bai ro'i sprul pa gsum dang mjal/ bar do dang rmi lam gyi man ngag shin tu zab par gnang*/ gdams ngag gi dri thug mdzad cing bka' stsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon no//

yang mtshur phur dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma gtso 'khor lnga'i zhal gzigs/ yang gnas de nyid du bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs/ yang mtshur phur bzhugs pa'i tshe/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams zhig tu byon pas/ sa gzhi thams cad me tog dkar pos kheb pa 'ja' tshon gyi gur phub pa'i dbus na bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po bzhugs pa dang mjal/ sman gyi ril bu mang po gnang ste 'di kun gzhan la byin na phan par 'gyur ro zhes gsung pa gzigs/ yang mtshur phur dpal bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa zhal gzigs/ yang mtshur phur sngags mchod cig mdzad pa'i dus su bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal gzigs/ yang mtshur phur rje btsun ma'i mchod pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ de nyid kyi zhal gzigs/ yang mtshur phur dpal gshin rje'i gshed thod pa bzhi dang bcas pa zhal gzigs te/ de'i thugs dam gyi thang sku yang bris/ yang mtshur phur nub gcig gi rmang lam na/ lho nub kyi mtshams na 'ur sgra chen po zhig grags te gzigs pas/ 'od phung gi nang du bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rus pa'i rgyan can/ phyag na ḍa ma ru thogs pa zhig na re/ kho bo mai tri pa yin gsungs/ de'i zhal nas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad gnyis su 'dus/ nyon mongs pa can gyi yid dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i yid gnyis yin/ nyon mongs pa can yang lhan cig skyes pa'i yid du 'dus so/ /zhes gsungs nas 'ja' yal ba bzhin du song ngo*/ /yang zla ba de'i nyi shu bdun gyi nub mo rmang lam du/ sgam por byon te 'ja' tshon gyi snam bu zhig 'dug pa rje btsun nyid kyi phyag gis brdog gin byon pas/ dge 'phrang du bla ma lha rje rin po che dang mjal/ rang gi dag snang shar tshul rnams zhus pas/ bu chos thams cad rmi lam dang 'ja' tshon lta bur shes par gyis shig gsung ste 'ja' bzhin du yal lo//

yang sbrul zla'i nyi shu gsum gyi nub mo rmang lam na 'od phung zhig gi nang du rnal 'byor pa phyag g.yas pa mda' 'dzin zhing*/ bya byed thams cad g.yon gyis byed pa cig gis zhal nas/ nga ni su yin ma shes na// nga ni sa ra ha par grags// gsung*/gdams ngag zhus pas/ mtha' dang bral ba lta ba yin// yengs pa med pa sgoms pa yin// dgag sgrub med na spyod pa yin// spang thob med na 'bras bu yin// gsungs te 'ja' bzhin du yal lo// yang re zhig bla ma stag del bas zhus pa/ rje btsun rin po che khyed sprul pa mang pos dus gcig tu 'gro don mdzad par gda' ba/ da lta 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ci tsam yod zhus pas/ spyir nges pa med mod kyi/ 'on kyang shin tu gsal ba bzhi tsam yod pa 'dra/ de rnams gang lags zhus pas/ mnga' ris kyi pha rol/ kha che'i tshu rol pu hrangs shes bya ba na/ dge slong dge ba'i blo gros zhes bya ba gtsug lag khang mang po bzhengs/ sngar gyi slob ma btsun chung cig shi ba der skyes ba de dang sems can mang po'i don mdzad cing yod gsungs/ yang bal bod kyi mtshams lan dhe zhes bya bar bla ma bai ro'i dgon pa yod de/ de na dge bsnyen chos kyi grags pa zhes bya ba chos brda'i tshul du gsungs pa yod/ yang rgya gar lho phyogs na rten rnal 'byor par grags pa zhig yod/ snang ba dag pa rnams kyis thugs rje chen po rang du mthong*/ sa 'dir bzhugs 'dir byon gyi nges pa med pa zhig bzhugs/ yang shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams zhig na grub thob rgyal po'i cha byad can mtshan grags pa mtha' yas zhes bya ba rgyal khams de rgyal po min pas mi thul bas/ rgyal po'i cha lugs su mdzad de 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/ gzhan yang du ma yod pa 'dra gsungs/ de ltar rang dang gzhan gyi dus gsum gyi gnas dpag par dka' ba dpag tu med pa mkhyen cing*/ thar thor tsam gdul bya skal ldan dag la'ang gsung par mdzad pas/

mtshan yang*/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa zhes nyi zla ltar grags shing rtsod pa med par gyur pa yin/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas kyang*/ dpal rdo rje gdan pas sngon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis bus pa'i rdo rje gdan gyi tshogs dung bskur te/ da lta sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dngos gzhi bod yul du yod cing bstan pa'i bdag po shrī dharma kīrti yin pas phul zhig ces 'bul du btang ba phyis gan+dho la'i mchod bshams la bzhugs/ de ltar sku skye ba de nyid kyis sems can dpag med smin grol la bkod de/ mya ngan las 'da' ba'i snga rol zla ba gsum tsam nas/ nam mkha' la 'ja' dang*/ sa g.yo ba dang*/ 'ur thug gi sgra la sogs pa ltas chen po rgyun ma chad pa byung*/ glang gi lo stag gi zla ba'i tshes gcig gi nyin par/ dge bshes gtsang pa dpon g.yog dang*/ dpon 'dul dang*/ dpon grags dang*/ grags rin dang*/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang*/ na bun pa la sogs pa gra bgres 'ga' zhig la zhal ta byon pa/ kho bo la bdag tu gzung ba gos lus gang 'di dang*/ zhib 'thag pa'i rang 'thag 'di las med/ gzhan yo byad thams cad dge 'dun bying dbang ba yin te/ gser srang brgya nyi shu rtsa gnyis/ dngul dang*/ g.yu dang*/ dar zab mdzo rta la sogs mang du yod pa 'di rnams khyed mi lngas bdag po gyis la nas su sgrubs grwa pa rnams la khyed kho bo 'das pa'i shul 'dir lo gcig gnyis sdod gsungs/ dpon grags seng gis sdod pa rang 'ong ngam zhus pas/ sku yar bzhengs spyan hur mdzad nas ma tha yang dbyar dgun gnyis tsam sdod pa'ang min nam gsung*/ yang gzhon nu khyod kyis lo gcig gnyis 'dir sdod la kho bo'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams las yi ge gcig kyang ma 'thor ba gyis/ ngas kyang chos skyong la bka' bsgo zhing gnyer du gtad yod pa yin gsungs/ tshe gcig nas gnyis su 'gro ba'i nub mo sa g.yos gcig rjes su gcig brengs ma chad pa dang*/

yang dgon gyi steng du 'ja' tshon gyi gdugs 'khrigs pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs mang pos ḍā ma ru'i sgra sgrogs pa la sogs pa'i ltas dpag tu med pa byung*/ de nas tshes gsum gyi nyin par grā pa thams cad la zhal bstan pa dang*/ gdams pa bstan pa dpag tu med pa mdzad/ sku drangs por bsrang ste nam mkha' la lta stangs yun ring du mdzad/ nyi ma phyi dro zad pa'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ rtag 'dzin can gyi gdul bya rnams yang dag pa'i lam la bskul ba'i phyir sprul pa sku'i dkyil 'khor bsdus te/ zhing khams gzhan du bde bar gshegs/ dgung lo ni brgyad cu gya bzhi pa'o/ chu mo glang*/ de nas tshes bcu la gdung bzhu ba'i tshe/ der 'tshogs pa rnams kyi snang ba la nyi ma sngar las nyis 'gyur gyis ring ba dang*/ la la la nyi ma bdun dang brgyad dang bcu gsum la sogs nyi ma'i tshogs 'dus shing gyes par mthong ba dang*/ nyi ma'i 'od zer rma bya'i gdugs 'dra ba dang*/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rus pa'i rgyan can gyis nam mkha'i khams gang ba dang*/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i me tog gi char rgyun mi 'chad pa dang*/ gdung khang gi gdugs kyi steng na rin po che dang 'ja' tshon gyi gdugs brtsegs mang po 'dug pa dang*/ ngos gzung med pa'i sgra snyan sna tshogs grags pa dang*/ du ba 'ja' tshon du gyur ba'i nang du bla ma sku dngos su bzhugs par mthong ba dang*/ ri dwags rnams 'dus nas gdung khang la bskor ba byed pa dang*/ nam mkha' la bya'i tshogs mang pos bskor ba byed cing sgra snyan po 'byin pa dang*/ sngar dge sbyor med pa rnams la dge sbyor skyes pa dang*/ dge sbyor yod pa rnams kyi bogs thon pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa skyes pa la sogs ngo mtshar brjod kyis mi langs pa byung ngo*//

de nas spur khang zhal phye ba'i tshe sems can la brtse ba'i phyir thugs dang*/ zab mo'i chos ston pa'i ljags dang*/ byang chub kyi sems brtan pas ring bsrel kha dog sna lnga pa dkar po shas che ba dang*/ bskyed pa'i rim pa brtan pas sa bon phyag mtshan lha sku la sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon/ gdul bya thams cad yang dag pa'i lam la nges pa'i shes pa brtan par mdzad do/ /de nas dge 'dun la la zhig mtshur phur dgon 'dzin pa dka' zhing*/ bar yul gyi snying po yin pas der dgon pa spo bar kha 'cham/ gdung rten dang sku 'bum yang der bzhengs par byas/ mchod khang gi rmang yang der bting ngo*/ /slob dpon shes rin gyi gsung gis mtshur phu'i dgon pa 'di chos kyi rje rin po che kam po gnas nang nas 'dir thugs gtad de byon/ tshogs pa dpag tu med pa'ang 'dus/ zhal chems su yang phog /sku yang 'dir gshegs/ gdung yang 'dir bzhus/ thugs dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal yang 'dir gzigs/ dbang rab gnas mang po yang mdzad de byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa gzhi phul du phyin pa 'di lta bu bzhag nas gar 'gro gsung ste/ dpon slob gsum gyis dam bca' mdzad de/ sku gdung bzhu ba'i sa spyan drangs ba'i 'o ma dang*/ dri bzang gdung thal rnams la rgyu byas pa'i chos rje'i sku tshad bzhengs/ nang du sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel dang*/ rje rin po che nyid la sogs pa bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi/ gdung ring bsrel/ dbu skra/ phyag zhabs kyi sen mo na bza' rnams bzhugs te/ phyi rabs pa rnams kyi mos pa'i rten du rje nyid kyi gzims mal du bzhugs so// yang sku 'bum zhig bzhengs dgongs nas/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten gyi bkod pa/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi lha bzo zhig la paṇ+ḍi ta nyi ma'i snying pos bzhengs bcug pa'i thang ga chen po zhig paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid kyis bod du bsnams te/ slob ma ston pa gnyis la gnang ba da lta dge bshes glan gyis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang la bzhugs zer ba thos nas/

dge bshes rnam 'bar ba'i dpon ston lha sar byon pa la 'grogs nas thang ka de las dpe blangs/ rnam 'bar ba'i slob ma rgya gar du lan gnyis phyin pa'i bal po lo tsā ba la mchod rten gyi dkar zhal dang*/ chag tshad bslab nas slar rin po che nyid kyi gsung gis yang dgon gyi rgyab 'dir dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten gcig bzhengs la bskor ba bya'o gsung pa'i zhal lung yod pas/ gdung bzhu ba'i sa de nyid du mchod rten gyi rmang btsugs pa'i cho ga mdzad pas/ kha ba chen po bab pa'i rjes la/ nam mkha' yongs su dag pa las 'ja' tshon gdugs dang dkyil 'khor 'dra ba mang po byung ngo*/ /de'i phyi nyin nas bzung ste mchod rten ma tshar gyi bar du 'ja' tshon dang me tog gi char rgyun ma chad pa byung*/ yun ring por ma thogs par tshar te/ de'i nang du spyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel dang*/ de bzhin gshegs glang po'i gdung dang*/ byang chub shing gi lo 'bras/ gnas chen po brgyad kyi sa/ li yul nas byon pa'i dpal kha sar pa ṇi'i sku cig gis sna drangs pa'i sku'i rten khyad par can bcu gcig /gser gyi glegs bam gsum la sogs pa gsung gi rten mang po/ chos rje rin po che nyid kyi dbu skra dang*/ sku gdang*/ ring bsrel/ phyag zhabs kyi sen mo/ na bza'/ bzhugs gdan zhabs rjes/ bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi yang sku gdung la sogs ngo mtshar gyi rten dpag tu med pa bzhugs shing*/ 'khor lo rim pa bcu gsum/ gdugs/ char khebs/ tog dang bcas pas mdzes pa'i logs la/ rin po che nyid sku 'od kyi rnam pa rang byung du byon pas thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur to/ /de'i rjes su rin po che'i thugs ljags bzhugs pa'i gdung khang sgom chen ras pas gzhi mdzad/ dus phyis rin po che gtsang po pas dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten la gser gyi na bza' bzang po bzo bo cha rkyen dang bcas pa mi nyag gi yul nas brdzangs te byung ba'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir/

nang gzhal yas khang dang*/ phyi mchod rten du yod pa'i 'bum khang*/ rgyar 'dom brgyad la chu zheng gab pa/ sgo bzhi las mkhan dang bcas pa/ bang rim rgyal po'i khang pa dang bcas pa bsgrubs te/ bal po'i yul nas spyan drangs pa'i gser gyi gan ji ra btsugs pas dgon gnas 'od dang ldan par byas te/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas kyi bar du 'gro ba thams cad kyi phyag dang mchod pa'i gnas su gyur pa/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don ji ltar bsams pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bur gyur to// de ltar rje dus mkhyen gyi rnam par thar pa sa bon tsam 'di ni/ sgang los bsgrigs pa'i rnam thar gser gling ma le'u bco brgyad pa dang*/ rnam thar tshigs bcad la zur cung zad mi 'dra ba gnyis/ spyan snga pa gzhon nu byang chub kyis bsgrigs pa'i rnam thar re'u mig ma dang*/ yang 'das rjes kyi rnam thar tshan gcig dang*/ mkha' spyod pas mdzad pa'i rnam thar dgos 'dod kun 'byung dang*/ gtsug lag phreng ba'i chos 'byung sogs nas kyang ci rigs par bsdus pa ste/ rje de la bu chen byon tshul rnam thar gser gling ma sogs su mi snang yang*/ rje dpa' bos rnam thar khungs ma gzhan gzigs pa na 'di ltar/ mngon shes kyi bka' babs lde chung sangs rgyas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi bka' babs 'ba' tsha stag del ba/ rnam thar gyi bka' babs bra ba bka' gdams pa/ rtogs pa'i bka' babs dbra dge chos brtson/ 'gro don gyi bka' babs 'gro mgon ras chen te bka' babs kyi bu lnga/ gya pa gangs pa/ rang byung sangs rgyas/ gtsang po pa dkon seng*/ 'gro mgon ras chen bsnan pas brgyud 'dzin gyi bu bzhi/ nam mkha' 'od/ ye shes 'od/ yon tan 'od/ dge 'dun 'od ste nye gnas 'od bzhi/ ye shes bla ma/ smon lam bla ma/ 'byung gnas bla ma/ rgyal mtshan bla ma ste bla ma bzhi/ dge slong brtson 'grus shes rab/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/

mdog mkhas pa/ rmeng ge jo sras te snga bu bzhi/ gtsang ston tshul seng*/ tre bo dkon mchog dpal/ rdo rje shes rab/ sgang lo tsā ba ste phyi bu bzhi ste yongs grags kyi bu chen rang nyid kho nas smin grol du mdzad pa rnams dang*/ lho la yag pa byang chub dngos grub/ dwags po 'dul ba 'dzin pa/ 'bri khung gi 'jig rten gsum mgon/ stag lung gi thang pa chen po/ rna phu'i gling ras pa/ ra lung gi gtsang pa rgya ras/ man lung pa'i dran ston mtha' bral/ ri gong gi sangs rgyas gnyan ston/ rgya pho ba lung pa sogs ni dam pa'i chos kyis 'brel ba'i skyes chen no/ /zhes snang gsungs shing deb sngon du zhang rin po che yang bu chen du bgrangs so// lho rong chos 'byung du ni/ rgya sgom ye shes 'od/ nye gnas smon lam 'od/ mtha' mi tshul khrims 'od/ a bang shes rab 'od de 'od che bzhi/ yon tan 'od/ dge 'dun 'od/ zhi ba 'od/ gling bu byang chub 'od de 'od chung ngu bzhi rnams te 'dren tshul mi mtshungs pa dang*/ lha rje me mchod pa/ rong po khams gsum grags/ sngags mchog bal po/ rma bya ras pa/ dge bshes na bun pa/ khams pa dbang rdor/ stag sgom ras pa/ dbon ston dar ma/ rdo rje brtson 'grus/ dar ma seng ge /dbang phyug grags pa/ rin chen grags pa/ shes rab grags/ ston pa byang chub grags/ dge 'dun grags/ shākya shes rab/ rdo rje 'bum/ dor pa stag del ba/ dam pa kaḥthog pa chen po sogs lhag por 'byung ngo*// de la lho la yag pa thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub dngos grub dang*/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin chen po ni/ bla ma lha rje'i dngos slob mched grogs kyi tshul nyid las/ bla ma rin po che la dad pa thob nas zhabs la gtugs pa yin la/ lho la yag pa de ni/ yab bo dhi rā dza dang yum zla sgron gyi sras su 'khrungs/ yi ge 'dri klog rdol shes su gyur/ sngags rnying ma'i mdo rgyud sogs dang*/ byams chos sogs dang*/
