la stod mkhar la'ang phar phyin sogs zhus/ dwags po'i slob ma zhig mjal bas dwags po'i drung du bskyal nas/ rje dwags pos rjes su bzung nas 'khor lo sdom pa dang phag mo'i dbang bskur mdzad/ lo bzhir bzhugs gdams ngag thams cad gnang*/ byang sems zla rgyal las bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ bla ma rngog gzhung pa las dgyes rdor zhus/ bla ma rin po che sku gshegs nas mtshur phu'i gdan sa lo gnyis gsum du mdzad/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa'i rnam thar du/ bla ma lho pa mdo po dgon na dbang bskur byed cing yod zer nas rmi lam bzung ltar phyin pas bla ma bde mchog dngos su byas nas dbang bskur zhing 'dug ste/ bdag gis kyang thob/ da lta bod na bde mchog dngos kyis dbang bskur nus pa bla ma lho pa las mi 'dug go zhis bris pa de yin/ rje sgam po pa'i sku 'dra yid bzhin nor bu yang mtshur phur bzhengs te spyan drangs nas slar sgam po'i gdan sa la byon/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin gyis kyang de'i 'og tu sgam po'i gdan sa mdzad/ grub thob gling ras kyis ni/ lo gtsang ra gsum/ rje dbu se/ zhang rin po che/ dpal phag mo gru pa rnams rtsa ba'i bla mar mtshungs par 'dzin te/ gsol 'debs sku lnga rab rdzogs las/ snang ba chos skur shar ba'i rgyal ba lo// dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig pa'i dam pa rje// thugs dgongs mkha' ltar dag pa'i mtha' rtsa ba// thams cad mkhyen pa rtsod med grags chen po// bde gshegs kun gyi dpal ldan rin po che// zhes rje phag gru pa dang*/ grub thob kun gyi rtsod med dbu se'i zhabs// gdul dka' 'dul mdzad 'gro mgon skye med zhang*// zhes pas tshal mtshur gnyis bstan pa yin la/ de bzhin du/ ras chung ba dang de yi sras// dpal ldan dam pa rnam gsum dang*// sgam po pa dang rin po che// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mtshur phu ba// skyes med zhang dang rin chen mchog/ ces dang*/ mtshur phu mdo bo'i dgon pa na//

de na khams pa dbu se bzhugs// dus gsum ma lus mkhyen pa'i rje// rje des kyang bu tsho byin gyis rlobs// ces sogs gling gi gsung mgur du ma na snang ngo*// 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyis kyang mtshur phur byon/ chos du ma gsan/ kho bo gtsang pa rgya ras bdag/ nyams myong glu ru len lags pas// rje rin po che 'di la gsan par zhu// zhes sogs nas lung bstan rjes su gnang du gsol/ zhes sogs kyi rtogs pa phul/ lung bstan gyi dgon pa bzhi la yang dbu ses lung bstan nas klong rdol btab/ ces gcig tu byed/ rna phu ba'i brgyud pa btsun pas 'dzin zhes pa'i lung bstan yang*/ mtshur phur bzhugs dus byung bas/ phyis zhang rin po che las rab tu byung*/ bar zhig zhwa khra zhig kyang bzhes yod par snang ste/ byang tshwa kha la byon nas tshur res sgom du 'ongs nas nor khyer na/ rten 'brel 'chug pas snod dkrogs gcig gsung dkrogs pas klung sgom gye snod nas krad pa cig byung ba'ang bskyur/ tshur lam sgo la lho pa'i jag pas mda' mdung gzengs byung bas bla ma dbu se'i lugs kyi dbu zhwa zhig yod pa de mthong nas mtshur phu bar 'dug zer nas bshol/ da res dbu zhā des srog mgo bton gsung bya ba rnam thar na snang zhing*/ de'i mgur na yang*/ srin po sgo pa lho pa yis// mi bsad nor khyer mthong tsa na// nged btson du ma bzung kha rje che// bka' brgyud kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa 'dra// 'di yang bla ma rje yi drin// zhes byung ngo*/ /grub chen man lung pa'ang dus gsum mkhyen pa la rdzu 'phrul gyis mtshur phur mjal/ byin rlabs ngo sprod gnang*/ khyod grub thob yin pas mtshur phu'i 'tshogs pa byin gyis rlobs gsungs pa ltar khas blangs/ zhes khong rang gis gsung bar grags/ ༈¿¿gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i bdag po rgyal ba kaḥthog pa ni/ rje 'di las bde mchog gi dbang bskur sogs zab chos mang du gsan pa'i slob ma'i mchog yin par snang ngo*/

/rgya pho ba lung pa yon tan bzang po la'ang khong rang gi sku skye snga ma'i ngos 'dzin gnang*/ bsngags pa mang du mdzad/ gdams pa'ang mang du gnang bar snang ngo*// nye gnas 'od bzhi'i nam mkha' 'od kyi skye ba rim par brgyud pa shar grags pa seng ge nas bzung ste zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa rnams yin no/ /de yang rje grags seng ba'i zhal nas sngon rgya gar du skyes pa bzhi tsam dran par 'dug pa la phal cher 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum dang*/ rje btsun sgrol ma la yi dam byed pa'i gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa sha stag yin par 'dug /zhib tu bshad kyang yid mi ches pas sdig can du 'gro gsung ba tsam dang*/ bod du tshul khrims dpal sogs kyi sku skye snga ma'i lo rgyus zhib mor gsungs pa yod la/ rje mkha' spyod pa'i skye ba snga 'grel dang*/ dran mang thugs rje'i lcags kyu sogs dang*/ spyan snga rin po che dang*/ rje chos kyi dbang phyug rnams kyi gsungs las kyang*/ sngon gyi tshul rgya cher 'byung mod kyi/ de dag so so'i rnam thar gyi skabs su 'chad par 'gyur zhing*/ 'dir sngon gyi tshul go rims bsgrig tu rung ba rnams grags seng ba dang*/ mkha' spyod pa'i gsung gung bstun nas mdo tsam bkod de/ /rje btsun til+li pa'i slob ma khol po dga' zhes bya ba las sku tshe 'phos nas nā ro pa'i slob ma dza lan+dha rar skyes pa'i bram ze kun rig ces bya ba zhig tu gyur/ de bal por gzhon nu gsang tshol du gyur te/ des sngags kyi man ngag mang du thob ste/ de nas bsams pa/ sngags kyi tshul las sngags la ma brten par sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub la/ sngags kyang bla ma kho na la rag las par gsung na/ bla ma dam pa dang mjal bar smon lam gdab cing gnas pa'i tshe/ nags su me tog 'thur phyin pa na sprin gyi gseb na gnas pa'i gzhon nu ma rgyan du mas brgyan pa zhig gis/ bu bu byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs//

rgyal bas lung bstan bod ces grags pa'i yul// der song khyod kyi 'dod pa 'grub byed de// bde gshegs nyid sprul khyod kyis mthong bar 'gyur// zhes lung ston du byung bas/ rang gi bla ma rgya gar phyag na la gsol ba des gnang nas/ byang phyogs su phyin pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po dang mjal bas dad pa rab tu 'phel bas smon lam yang yang du btab/ de nas rje btsun mi la dang mjal te phyag mang du btsal/ mchi ma blags/ zhabs la gtugs te smon lam btab pas/ rje btsun mi las/ khyod ni kha ba can ljongs 'dir// yang yang skye zhing chos spyod de// mi las 'das kyang mi gzugs kyis// 'gro ba 'dren pa rnams dang 'phrad// gang la yid ni rtse gcig par// sngon gyi bsod nams mthus bskyed de// nges par de 'bras myur smin zhing*// 'dod grub slar grub byed pa nyid// ces bya ba la sogs pa lung bstan mang du mdzad/ de nas bal bod kyi sa mtshams su dka' thub la gnas pa las sku tshe 'phos te/ dbu ru stod du yab dge bsnyen 'byung seng dang*/ yum sgrol ma 'bum gyi sras su me pho byi ba la 'khrungs/ rje sgam po ba khu dbon gyi spyan sngar byon te/ lo bcu dgu la khu dbon gyi drung du chig rdzogs mdzad/ mtshan tshul khrims dpal du gsol/ bka' gdams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po dang*/ rje ras chung ba/ phag mo gru pa/ khyung tshang pa/ rmog cog pa/ rje 'ba' rom pa/ rnal 'byor chos g.yung sogs bla ma mang du bsten/ gtso bor rje khu dbon gnyis la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes pa rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung*/ chos rje dus gsum mkhyen pa rje dwags po khu dbon dang mjal du byon pa'i tshe/ khong la dad pa dpag tu med pa skyes/ rdo rje dril bu zhig phul nas chos kyang mang du zhus/ de yang so bdun pa chu pho byi ba'i tshe gshegs/ de dus kyi slob ma'ang*/ slob dpon ston pa dang*/ slob dpon g.ya' bzang ba gnyis yin/

gzhan yang chos kyi 'brel pa yod pa kha yar yod gsungs/ de'i sku skye dge slong nam mkha' 'od ni ru mtshams kyi sa'i char/ yab dgon pa don grub bla ma dang*/ yum lha mo lcam gyi sras su chu mo glang gi lo la 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas sngon gyi bla ma dran zhing dad pa skyes te/ lo brgyad dgu la chos rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la phul/ lo brgyad dam dgur phyags phyir 'bral med bsdad/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa dpag med mdzad/ byis pa'i spyod pa med par mos gus kyis bla ma bsten zhing*/ gdams pa rtsad bcad pas rje shin tu mnyes par gyur/ chos rje khams su gshegs rjes gangs dkar dang*/ se mo do dang*/ kha rag dang*/ thang lha la sogs pa'i dben pa rnams su bsgoms mtshams bar du 'gro mgon zhang dang*/ lho pa dang*/ skyer sgang ba dang*/ gling la sogs pa dam pa mang du mjal zhing gdams pa gsan/ khyad par bde gshegs stag lung thang pa la dad pa rab tu thob nas chos zhus/ gtso bor sgrub pa kho na byas/ de nas chos rje dbus su pheb nas gdams pa lhag ma dang*/ rjes su gdams pa dpag tu med pa gnang*/ de nas lo bcu bdun du 'tshams 'ba' zhig byas/ ting nge 'dzin phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ nam mkhar 'phur ba sogs grub pa'i rtags mtshan kyang 'ga' re rnyed par gyur/ mtshur phu'i phug mo che'i ri khrod btab ste/ bzhugs pas slob ma yang bdun cu tsam byung*/ sgom chen nyams myong dang ldan pa yang kha yar byung*/ grub thob chu sgom mar grags pa'ang*/ rje 'di la chos drug gi gsal 'debs zhus pa'i slob mar 'dug drug cu rtsa bdun pa sa mo lug la gshegs/

༈ chos rje gya ba gangs par grags pa de ni/ yul shangs/ rus khyung po yin pa'i yab gsang sngags rnying ma ba zhig gi sras su shing mo lug la 'khrungs/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i drug cu rtsa drug pa yin/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan rin chen 'od zer/ khong rang gi mes seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta phra la ring mo la gsan yang zer te/ mi rabs ya zung du phur pa lha nag gi grub thob byung ba'i brgyud yin yang chos kyis thugs cung ma tshim bar rje dus mkhyen jo mo gangs la bzhugs dus mjal/ chos bka' rnams zhus pas thugs nges chen po 'khrungs/ der sgrub pa mdzad pas gangs dkar bar grags/ so ye shes dbang phyug la sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i skor gsan/ gzhan yang 'bri khung chos rje/ stag lung thang pa/ rmog lcog pa/ la yag pa/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin/ nye gnas gsal byang*/ kha che paṇa chen la sogs pa'i bla ma mang du bsten/ gtso bo mdo bo ras pa ste/ de las phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa brnyes/ gya bar 'brang bu'i dgon rnying btab/ de'i dbon brgyud kyis dus phyis bar du dgon gsar rnying rnams bzung nas dar rgyas che zhing*/ kaṃ tshang gi zhabs tog che bar grags/ khong gi tshe'i mtha' la hor dmag bod du lhags/ rang lo bdun cu rtsa lnga pa sa mo bya la mtshur phur gshegs/ de'i slob ma bsam gling rin po che ni myang smad gyi sgro lung ser chung ba'i khu lung du/ yab mes rngog rdo rje dbang phyug ces bya ba la sras phug pa mgon/ phug pa rgyal/ phug pa dar te de gsum gyi che ba phug pa mgon dang por rta nag tu mi g.yog byas/ de nas ding rir phyin nas rnal 'byor par gyur/ de nas shab zho nga ba'i rnal 'byor ma dar ma lcam yang ding ri na yod pa de nyid kyi sras su sa mo bya la 'khrungs/ lo nyer gcig la dpyal chos bzang dang*/¿gtsang pa sar sbos gnyis kyis mkhan slob mdzad de rab tu byung*/ bla ma mang du bsten nas thos pa rgya chen po mdzad/

dpyal gyi zur chos pa'ang lo mang du byas/ myang stod kyi ser phreng dgon pa na dwags po bka' brgyud pa'i sgom chen cig yod pa de la lnga ldan la sogs zhus pas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa brnyes/ gangs pa rin chen 'od zer gyi zhabs la gtugs nas chos mang du gsan zhing ko brag pa'i yang slob ma yin/ sku tshe'i smad la myang smad bsam gling btab/ rtogs pa mtho zhing 'gro don rgya che/ rang lo don gnyis pa lcags sprel la gshegs/ 'di chos rje rgod tshang pa dang 'khrungs lo gcig cing*/ rgod tshang pa las lo gnyis kyis sku tshe ring*/ phyis su gya pa gangs pa'i dbon brgyud la/ 'brong bu go shri zhes pa'ang byung zhing*/ de nas rim pa bzhin sog rtsā ldan gyi dgon pa zam dang bcas pa'i bdag 'dzin mdzad nas phrin las che bar byung*/ da lta'ang bod sog tshor dbon brgyud ma chad tsam zhig snang*/ ༈¿¿rgya sgom ye shes 'od ni/ rin po che karma pa'i brgyud rim na'ang bzhugs shing grub thob rtsod med du grags/ ༈¿¿smon lam 'od ni/ yun ring du nye gnas mdzad cing yon tan du ma mnga'/ ༈¿¿mtha' mi tshul khrims 'od kyis 'dob spang phug gi gdan sa mdzad/ de'i slob ma a bong shes rab 'od kyis yang ldem gyi dgon pa btab pa dus phyis bar du dar rgyas che/ ༈¿¿lde chung sangs rgyas rin chen ni/ 'khrungs yul rngu+u sa dmar ba yin/ rin po che dang mjal nas chos khrid rnams rdzogs par zhus/ yon tan dpag tu med pa rgyud la skyes/ de'i slob ma skye med khe sgom yin zhing*/ sha grags pa seng ges kyang dang po 'dir thug de'i dpon po khe ye shes seng ges yon po'i dgon pa bzung nas phyis kyi bar du dgon pa dang bu slob kyi dar rgyas legs po byung*/ zhes grags/ ༈¿¿'ba' tsha stag del ba ni/ zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin la mnga' brnyes/ slob ma yang mang du 'dus shing sku lus de nyid kyis mkha' spyod du gshegs par grags/

༈¿¿dbra sgom chos brtson ni/ rus dbra/ de'i nang tshan re khe ste/ 'khrungs yul bso rong re khe chu rgyud yin/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i drung du chos ka rnams zhus pas nyams rtogs phul byung brnyes/ de'i sku skye phyi ma la bstan pa'i zhabs tog kyang rgya chen po mdzad par grags/ ༈¿¿gtsang pa bkra shis sam gtsang po ba dkon mchog seng ge ni/ la stod thang chung na rdzu 'phrul gyis rjes su bzung nas slar mtshur phur gdams ngag rdzogs par mdzad de/ mi nyag 'ga'i rgyal pos rje nyid spyan drangs par/ gtsang po ma la phag mo'i bskyed rdzogs 'gro chos su gnang nas ha la shan gyi ri bor sgoms shig lung bstan te sku tshab tu brdzangs/ der 'ga'i rgyal po'i bla ma mdzad de mtshan gtsang pa ti shrir thogs/ khong gis gdan sa chen po mtshur phur/ dang po gser 'bum gyi na bza' dang*/ phyi'i mchod rten bzhengs pa'i cha rkyen/ gnyis pa mchod khang gong ma'i khyams/ gsum pa mchod rdzas dang dgon pa'i khyad 'phags bcu gsum rnams rim pa bzhin du phul ba sogs bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad nas sa pho stag gi lo la 'ga'i byang ngos su sku gshegs/ de'i slob ma ni 'gro mgon ti shri ras pa ste/ 'ba' dbram bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i rtsa lag mi nyag rgyal po'i dbu bla'o/ gshegs rdzong lha khang gdung rten dang bcas pa ti shri ras pas mdzad/ ༈¿¿bra ba bka' gdams pā ru yon po do'i dgon pa bzung nas bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad par grags/ ༈¿¿lha rje me mchod pa ni/ rin po che las chos khrid thams cad rdzogs par nos shing*/ rnal 'byor chos g.yung las kyang chos ka ci rigs gsan/ le smad du dgon pa mdzad dgongs pa'i tshe/ de nas pha ra zhes nam mkha' las sgra byung bar brten/ de nyid nas phan tsam du dgon pa mdzad pas/ phyis pha ra dgon du grags/ de'i slob ma ri khrod pa chen po dang*/ dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang*/ spyan snga rin po che sogs nas yun ring du bshad sgrub 'phel bar byung*/

༈¿¿rong po khams gsum grags ni/ rnal 'byor pa sngags pa'i tshul te/ sog rong du byung*/ ༈¿¿sngags mchog bal po zhes pas gla li na rdza bkra rin chen sgang btab/ ༈¿¿sgang lo tsā ba ni/ mtshur gyi sgang bu dgon par byung ste/ rnam thar gser gling ma mdzad pa po de yin/ ༈¿¿rma bya ras pa ni/ tshong dus mgur mo'i dgon pa dang*/ nyang shar phyogs su bzhugs nas phrin las chen po byung zhing*/ chos brgyud kyang mang du byung bar 'dug ༈¿¿dge bshes na bun pa ni/ 'khrungs yul na bun rdzong pa ste/ 'chams gshis su dgon pa btab nas 'gro don mdzad/ ༈¿¿khams pa dbang rdor gyis pha khang du dgon pa mdzad nas bzhugs/
